en.q: Regarding the grant of a licence to operate a money service under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where the applicant is a partnership, each partner in the partnership must be a fit and proper person to operate a money service.
If a corporate applicant has an ultimate owner, the ultimate owner must be fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
For a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied that every director and every shareholder is fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
For an application to operate at particular premises, the Commissioner must be satisfied that the premises are suitable for operating a money service.
Once satisfied of every matter that the Ordinance requires, the Commissioner must grant the licence to the applicant.
notes: Correct: section 30(3)(a)(ii)(A) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that each partner in the partnership is a fit and proper person to operate a money service.

Correct: section 30(3)(a)(iii)(B) requires, if there is an ultimate owner in relation to the corporation, that the ultimate owner is a fit and proper person to be associated with the business of operating a money service.
Incorrect: section 30(3)(a)(iii) names each director of the corporation and, if there is one, its ultimate owner; it does not require each shareholder to be a fit and proper person.
Correct: section 30(3)(b)(i) requires, for an application to operate a money service at any particular premises, that the premises are suitable to be used for the operation of a money service.

Incorrect: section 30(2) provides that the Commissioner may grant a licence, and section 30(3) that the Commissioner may do so only if satisfied; the Commissioner keeps a discretion and is not obliged to grant one.

tc.q: 關於根據《打擊洗錢條例》批給經營金錢服務的牌照，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如申請人屬合夥，該合夥的每名合夥人均須屬經營金錢服務的適當人選。
如就屬法團的申請人有最終擁有人，該名最終擁有人須屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。
就屬法團的申請人而言，關長須信納其每名董事及每名股東均屬與經營金錢服務有聯繫的適當人選。
就要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請而言，關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務。
關長一經信納條例規定的所有事宜均已符合，便必須向申請人批給牌照。
notes: 正確：第30(3)(a)(ii)(A)條規定，關長須信納該合夥的每名合夥人均屬經營金錢服務的適當人選。
正確：第30(3)(a)(iii)(B)條規定，如就法團有最終擁有人，該名最終擁有人須屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。
不正確：第30(3)(a)(iii)條只規定法團的每名董事及（如有的話）其最終擁有人須屬適當人選，並無規定每名股東均須如此。
正確：第30(3)(b)(i)條規定，就要求在任何特定處所經營金錢服務的申請而言，關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務。
不正確：第30(2)條訂明關長「可」批給牌照，第30(3)條則訂明關長僅可在信納有關情況下批給牌照；關長仍有酌情權，並無責任必須批給。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)條

en.q: In determining whether a person is a fit and proper person for the grant of a licence, which of the following matters does the AMLO require the Commissioner to have regard to?
statements: A conviction of the person outside Hong Kong for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing
A conviction of the person in Hong Kong for any offence that carries a possible sentence of imprisonment
A persistent failure by the person to comply with requirements imposed under the AMLO or regulations made by the Commissioner
For an individual, any adjudication of bankruptcy under the Bankruptcy Ordinance at any time in the past
For a corporation, being in liquidation or the subject of a winding up order, or having a receiver appointed in relation to it
A conviction of the person for the offence under the AMLO of knowingly contravening a specified provision
notes: Correct: section 30(4)(b)(ii) has the Commissioner have regard to whether the person has a conviction in a place outside Hong Kong for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing.

Incorrect: section 30(4)(a) lists convictions for particular offences under the AMLO, the UNATMO, the DTROP and the OSCO; a conviction for any offence punishable by imprisonment is not among the matters it names.
Correct: section 30(4)(c) covers whether the person has persistently failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the Ordinance or any regulation made by the Commissioner under section 51.

Incorrect: section 30(4)(d) asks whether the individual is an undischarged bankrupt or is the subject of any bankruptcy proceedings; a bankruptcy from which the person has been discharged is not the matter it names.
Correct: section 30(4)(e) covers whether the person, being a corporation, is in liquidation or is the subject of a winding up order, or there is a receiver appointed in relation to it.
Correct: section 30(4)(a)(i) lists a conviction for an offence under section 5(5), which a financial institution commits if it knowingly contravenes a specified provision.

tc.q: 關長在斷定某人是否屬批給牌照所需的適當人選時，《打擊洗錢條例》規定關長須顧及下列哪些事宜？
statements: 該人在香港以外地方因關乎洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的罪行而被定罪
該人在香港因任何一項可判處監禁的刑事罪行而被裁定有罪
該人屢次不遵從根據《打擊洗錢條例》施加的要求或關長訂立的規例
（就個人而言）該人曾在任何時候根據《破產條例》被判定破產
（就法團而言）該人正在清盤、屬清盤令的標的，或已有接管人就其獲委任
該人因《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的明知而違反指明的條文的罪行而被定罪
notes: 正確：第30(4)(b)(ii)條規定關長須顧及該人是否曾在香港以外地方被裁定犯關乎洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的罪行。
不正確：第30(4)(a)條列出的是本條例、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》下的指明罪行；任何可判處監禁的罪行並不在所列事宜之內。
正確：第30(4)(c)條訂明關長須顧及該人是否屢次不遵從根據本條例施加的要求或關長根據第51條訂立的任何規例。
不正確：第30(4)(d)條所指的是該人是否未獲解除破產的破產人或破產程序的標的；已獲解除破產的人並不在此列。
正確：第30(4)(e)條訂明關長須顧及該人是否正在清盤當中，或是否任何清盤令的標的，或是否有接管人已就該人而獲委任。
正確：第30(4)(a)(i)條列出第5(5)條所訂罪行，即金融機構明知而違反指明的條文的罪行。

en.q: Regarding the validity and renewal of a licence to operate a money service under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Subject to revocation or suspension, a licence is valid for 2 years from the date of grant, or another period the Commissioner determines in a particular case.
Subject to revocation or suspension, a renewed licence is valid for 2 years, or a longer period the Commissioner determines in a particular case.
A licensee seeking renewal must apply to the Commissioner, in the specified form and manner and with the Schedule 3 fee, at least 45 days before its licence is due to expire.
The matters of which the Commissioner must be satisfied before granting a licence, and those for judging fitness and propriety, apply equally to an application for renewal.
A licence expiring before its renewal is decided stays in force until renewed or until a refusal takes effect, unless the application is withdrawn or the licence revoked or suspended.
notes: Correct: section 30(10) makes a licence granted valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in any particular case, any other period determined by the Commissioner, beginning on the date on which it is granted.

Incorrect: section 31(12) makes a renewed licence valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in a particular case, any shorter period the Commissioner determines; it provides for no longer period.

Correct: section 31(2) requires an application for renewal to be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire, in the form and manner the Commissioner specifies, with the fee specified in Schedule 3.

Correct: section 31(4) applies section 30(3) and (4), which set the matters of which the Commissioner must be satisfied and the matters for judging fitness and propriety, to an application for renewal as to an application for a licence.

Correct: section 31(10) keeps the licence in force until it is renewed or, if renewal is refused, until the refusal takes effect, unless the application is withdrawn or the licence is revoked or suspended under section 34.

tc.q: 關於根據《打擊洗錢條例》經營金錢服務的牌照的有效期及續期，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 除被撤銷或暫時吊銷外，牌照自批給當日起計有效2年，或關長在特定個案中決定的其他期間。
除被撤銷或暫時吊銷外，續期的牌照有效2年，或關長在特定個案中決定的較長期間。
持牌人最遲須在牌照期滿前45日，按關長指明的格式及方式向關長申請續期，申請並須附隨附表3指明的費用。
關長批給牌照前須信納的情況，以及斷定適當人選時須顧及的事宜，同樣適用於牌照續期申請。
牌照如在續期申請獲決定前期滿，在獲續期或拒絕續期的決定生效前仍有效，除非申請被撤回或牌照被撤銷或暫時吊銷。
notes: 正確：第30(10)條訂明，批給的牌照有效期為2年或（如關長在特定個案中認為適當的話）關長決定的其他期間，有效期自該牌照批給當日起計。
不正確：第31(12)條訂明續期的牌照有效期為2年或（如關長在特定個案中認為合適的話）關長決定的較短期間，並無較長期間的規定。
正確：第31(2)條規定，牌照續期的申請須在牌照期滿前45日或之前，以關長指明的格式及方式向關長提出，並附隨附表3指明的費用。
正確：第31(4)條訂明，第30(3)及(4)條（即關長批給牌照前須信納的情況及斷定適當人選時須顧及的事宜）適用於牌照續期申請，一如其適用於牌照申請。
正確：第31(10)條訂明，除非申請被撤回，或牌照根據第34條被撤銷或暫時吊銷，否則牌照在獲續期前，或在拒絕續期的決定生效前，仍然有效。

en.q: Regarding the offence of operating a money service without a licence under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: On conviction on indictment for the offence, a person is liable to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for a term of 2 years.
On summary conviction for the offence, a person is liable to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for a term of 1 year.
The court or magistrate may order a convicted person to be disqualified from holding a licence for a period specified in the order, beginning on the date of the order.
An authorized officer may arrest without a warrant a person whom the officer has reasonable grounds to suspect has committed or is committing the offence.
The Commissioner may issue a warrant authorizing an authorized officer to enter and search premises on which the offence is suspected of being committed.
notes: Correct: section 29(2)(a) makes a person who operates a money service without a licence liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
Incorrect: section 29(2)(b) provides for a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction, not 1 year.

Correct: section 29(3) lets the court or magistrate order that a person convicted under the section be disqualified from holding a licence for a period specified in the order, beginning on the date of the order.

Correct: section 48(1) lets an authorized officer, without a warrant, arrest or detain a person if the officer has reasonable grounds to suspect that the person has committed or is committing an offence under section 29.
Incorrect: under section 47(1) the warrant is issued by a magistrate who is satisfied by information on oath that there are reasonable grounds to suspect the offence, not by the Commissioner.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》所訂在沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務的罪行，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 該罪行的犯罪者一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
任何人犯該罪行，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁1年。
法庭或裁判官可命令取消被定罪的人在命令指明的、始於命令日期的期間持有牌照的資格。
獲授權人員如有合理理由懷疑某人已犯或正在犯該罪行，可無需手令而將該人拘捕。
關長可發出手令，授權獲授權人員進入和搜查懷疑有人於其內犯該罪行的處所。
notes: 正確：第29(2)(a)條訂明，在沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務的人，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
不正確：第29(2)(b)條訂明，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月，並非1年。
正確：第29(3)條訂明，如任何人被裁定犯該條所訂罪行，法庭或裁判官可命令取消該人在命令指明的始於該命令的日期的期間持有牌照的資格。
正確：第48(1)條訂明，如獲授權人員有合理理由懷疑任何人已犯或正在犯第29條所訂罪行，該人員可無需手令而將該人拘捕或扣留，以作進一步查訊。
不正確：第47(1)條訂明，手令由根據經宣誓而作的告發而信納有合理理由懷疑有人犯該罪行的裁判官發出，並非由關長發出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)至(2)及42條

en.q: Regarding the cessation of a licensee's money service business and the events on which a licence ceases to be valid under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation, the licensee must return its licence to the Commissioner for cancellation or amendment.
A licensee that ceases to operate at only one of the premises specified in its licence must return the licence to the Commissioner for amendment.
The Commissioner must cancel or amend a returned licence, and delete the relevant particulars from the register, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving it.
Where the licensee is an individual, the licence ceases to be valid as soon as the individual is convicted of any offence under the AMLO.
A licence ceases to be valid on the dissolution of a licensee that is a partnership, or on the commencement of the winding up of one that is a corporation.
notes: Correct: section 41(1)(b) requires the licensee to return the licence to the Commissioner for cancellation or amendment within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation.

Correct: section 41(1) applies also where a licensee intends to cease to operate a money service at any of the premises specified in the licence, and paragraph (b) requires the licence to be returned for cancellation or amendment.
Correct: section 41(2) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the licence, to cancel or amend it and to remove the relevant particulars from the register.

Incorrect: section 42 ends a licence's validity on the death of an individual licensee, the dissolution of a partnership or the commencement of winding up of a corporation; a conviction is not among these events.
Correct: section 42(b) and (c) provide that a licence ceases to be valid, for a partnership, on the dissolution of the partnership and, for a corporation, on the commencement of its winding up.

tc.q: 關於持牌人停業及牌照不再有效的情況，根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 由停業日期起計的7日內，持牌人須把牌照交回關長，供關長取消或修訂。
持牌人如只停止在牌照指明的其中一個處所經營，亦須將牌照交回關長以作修訂。
收到交回的牌照後，關長須在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快把牌照取消或修訂，並把有關詳情從登記冊刪除。
持牌人如屬個人，牌照在該名個人被裁定犯《打擊洗錢條例》所訂罪行時即不再有效。
持牌人如屬合夥，牌照在該合夥解散時即不再有效；如屬法團，則在該法團開始清盤時即不再有效。
notes: 正確：第41(1)(b)條規定持牌人須在自停業日期起計的7日內，將牌照交回關長，以作取消或修訂。
正確：第41(1)條亦適用於持牌人擬停止在牌照指明的任何處所經營金錢服務的情況，而(b)段規定須將牌照交回關長，以作取消或修訂。
正確：第41(2)條規定關長在收到牌照後，須在合理地切實可行範圍內，盡快取消或修訂該牌照，並在登記冊中刪除有關詳情。
不正確：第42條訂明牌照在屬個人的持牌人去世、合夥解散或法團開始清盤時不再有效；被定罪並不在其列。
正確：第42(b)及(c)條訂明，持牌人屬合夥的，牌照在該合夥解散時不再有效；屬法團的，則在該法團開始清盤時不再有效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38及39條

en.q: A licensee wishes to operate a money service at premises that are not yet added to its licence. Which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A licensee licensed at specified premises must not operate at other premises unless the Commissioner has, on its application, added them to the licence.
A licensee not required by its licence to operate at particular premises must not operate at any particular premises until the Commissioner adds them to the licence.
The Commissioner may grant an application to add premises on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3 and may impose any condition the Commissioner thinks fit.
After granting an application to add new premises, the Commissioner must enter the relevant particulars in the register within 14 days of the grant.
Operating at premises not added to the licence, without reasonable excuse, is an offence punishable on conviction by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
notes: Correct: section 38(1) bars a licensee licensed at specified premises from operating at any other premises unless the Commissioner has, on its application, added the new premises to the licence.

Correct: section 39(1) bars a licensee not required under its licence to operate at particular premises from operating at any particular premises unless the Commissioner has, on its application, added the premises to the licence.
Correct: sections 38(3) and 39(3) let the Commissioner grant the application on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3 and impose any condition the Commissioner thinks fit.
Incorrect: section 38(7) requires the Commissioner to add the relevant particulars to the register as soon as reasonably practicable after granting the application; it sets no period of 14 days.
Correct: sections 38(8) and 39(8) make a licensee who, without reasonable excuse, contravenes subsection (1) liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 持牌人擬在尚未加入其牌照的處所經營金錢服務。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 獲發牌在指明處所經營的持牌人，除非關長已應其申請將新處所加入牌照上，否則不得在新處所經營。
如牌照並無規定持牌人在特定處所經營，持牌人須待關長將特定處所加入牌照上，方可在該處所經營。
關長可在附表3指明的費用獲繳付後批准加入處所的申請，並可施加任何其認為合適的條件。
關長批准加入新處所的申請後，須在批准當日起計的14日內，在登記冊加入有關詳情。
在未加入牌照的處所經營而無合理辯解，即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
notes: 正確：第38(1)條訂明，除非關長已應持牌人的申請將指明處所以外的處所加入牌照上，否則持牌人不得在該新處所經營金錢服務。
正確：第39(1)條訂明，如牌照並無規定持牌人在特定處所經營金錢服務，則除非關長已應其申請將特定處所加入牌照上，否則持牌人不得在該處所經營。
正確：第38(3)及39(3)條訂明，關長可在附表3指明的費用獲繳付後批准申請，並可施加任何其認為合適的條件。
不正確：第38(7)條規定關長須在批准申請後，在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快在登記冊加入有關詳情，並無14日的規定。
正確：第38(8)及39(8)條訂明，持牌人無合理辯解而違反第(1)款，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35至37條

en.q: Regarding the Commissioner's approval of a person proposing to become a director, partner or ultimate owner of a licensee, which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: A person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing.
The Commissioner may approve a proposed director only if satisfied that the person is fit and proper to be associated with the licensee's money service business.
In judging whether a proposed partner is fit and proper, the Commissioner must have regard, among other relevant matters, to the matters listed for the grant of a licence.
A person who, without reasonable excuse, becomes a partner of a licensee without the Commissioner's approval is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
The approval must be applied for by the licensee, in the form and manner the Commissioner specifies, and the application must be accompanied by the Schedule 3 fee.
notes: Correct: section 36(1) provides that a person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing.
Correct: section 35(3) lets the Commissioner give the approval only if satisfied that the person is a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's money service business.
Correct: section 37(4) requires the Commissioner, in addition to any other matter the Commissioner considers relevant, to have regard to the matters specified in section 30(4)(a) to (e).
Correct: section 37(7) makes a person who, without reasonable excuse, contravenes section 37(1) liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

Correct: under sections 35(1), 36(1) and 37(1) the approval is given on an application of the licensee, and subsection (2) of each section requires it to be made in the specified form and manner with the fee specified in Schedule 3.

tc.q: 關於擬成為持牌人的董事、合夥人或最終擁有人的人須獲關長批准的規定，根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 除非關長已應持牌人的申請而給予書面批准，否則任何人不得成為該持牌人的最終擁有人。
關長須信納擬任董事屬與經營持牌人金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選，方可給予批准。
關長在斷定擬成為合夥人的人是否適當人選時，除其他有關事宜外，亦須考慮批給牌照時須顧及的事宜。
任何人無合理辯解而在未獲關長批准下成為持牌人的合夥人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
批准須由持牌人申請，申請須採用關長指明的格式及方式，並須附隨附表3指明的費用。
notes: 正確：第36(1)條訂明，除非關長已應持牌人的申請而給予書面批准，否則任何人不得成為該持牌人的最終擁有人。
正確：第35(3)條訂明，關長須信納有關的人屬與經營持牌人金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選，方可給予批准。
正確：第37(4)條規定關長除須考慮其認為有關的任何其他事宜外，亦須考慮第30(4)(a)、(b)、(c)、(d)及(e)條指明的事宜。
正確：第37(7)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而違反第37(1)條，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
正確：第35(1)、36(1)及37(1)條訂明關長應持牌人的申請給予批准，而各條第(2)款規定申請須以關長指明的格式及方式提出，並附隨附表3指明的費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27及28條

en.q: Regarding the register of licensees that the Commissioner maintains under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: For a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises, the register must contain the address of every premises at which it may operate a money service.
For a licensee not licensed to operate at specified premises, the register must contain the correspondence address of the licensee instead.
Members of the public may inspect the register during normal office hours on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3.
A certificate purporting to be signed by the Commissioner, stating that a person's name has not been entered on the register, is conclusive evidence of that fact.
A copy of the register purporting to be certified by the Commissioner is conclusive evidence, in any criminal or civil proceedings, of the facts stated in it.
notes: Correct: section 27(1)(b)(i) requires the register to contain, for a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises, the address of every premises at which the licensee may operate a money service.
Correct: section 27(1)(b)(ii) requires the register to contain, in any other case, the correspondence address of the licensee.

Incorrect: section 27(4) entitles members of the public to inspect the register without charge during normal office hours; the Schedule 3 fee under section 28(1) is for obtaining copies, extracts or certificates.
Correct: section 28(4) makes such a certificate admissible in evidence in any criminal or civil proceedings on production without further proof, and conclusive evidence of the facts stated in it.
Incorrect: section 28(2) makes a certified copy evidence of the facts stated in it; only a certificate under section 28(4) is made conclusive evidence.

tc.q: 關於關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》備存的持牌人登記冊，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如持牌人獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有其可經營金錢服務的每一個處所的地址。
如持牌人並非獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有該持牌人的通訊地址。
公眾人士須繳付附表3指明的費用，方可在通常辦公時間內查閱登記冊。
看來是經關長簽署並述明某人的姓名或名稱未有名列於登記冊的證明書，可作為該事實的確證。
看來是經關長核證的登記冊複本，在任何刑事或民事法律程序中，可作為該複本所述事實的確證。
notes: 正確：第27(1)(b)(i)條規定，如持牌人獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有該持牌人可經營金錢服務所在的每一個處所的地址。
正確：第27(1)(b)(ii)條規定，如屬任何其他情況，登記冊須載有該持牌人的通訊地址。
不正確：第27(4)條訂明公眾人士有權在通常辦公時間內免費查閱登記冊；第28(1)條所指附表3的費用，是用於取得登記冊的複本、摘錄或證明書。
正確：第28(4)條訂明，該證明書在任何刑事或民事法律程序中一經交出，即可作為該證明書所述事實的確證，而無需進一步證明。
不正確：第28(2)條訂明，經核證的複本可作為該複本所述事實的證據；只有第28(4)條所指的證明書才可作為確證。

en.q: Regarding the powers of an authorized person carrying out a routine inspection of a licensed money service operator under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: The authorized person may enter the business premises of the operator at any time, to ascertain whether it is complying with a prescribed requirement.
The authorized person may require the operator to give access to a specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified by the authorized person.
The authorized person may make inquiries of an information holder only with reasonable cause to believe the information cannot be obtained from the operator.
Where a person does not answer for lack of knowledge of the information, the authorized person may in writing require that fact and reason to be verified by statutory declaration.
When exercising a power, the authorized person must as soon as reasonably practicable produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization for inspection.
notes: Incorrect: section 9(1A)(a) lets the authorized person enter the business premises of the inspection subject at any reasonable time, not at any time.

Correct: section 9(3)(a) and (4)(a) let the authorized person require the inspection subject to give access to any specified business record and to produce it within the time and at the place the authorized person specifies.

Correct: section 9(6) allows inquiries of an information holder only if the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe that the information sought cannot be obtained by making inquiries of the inspection subject.
Correct: section 9(10) lets the authorized person require in writing that the person verify, within the time specified, that fact and reason by statutory declaration.

Correct: section 9(14) requires the authorized person, when exercising a power under the section, to produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization for inspection as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 關於獲授權人根據《打擊洗錢條例》對持牌金錢服務經營者進行例行視察的權力，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 獲授權人可於任何時間進入該經營者的業務處所，以確定其是否正遵從訂明規定。
獲授權人可要求該經營者讓其取覽指明業務紀錄，並在其指明的限期內及指明的地點交出該等紀錄。
獲授權人須有合理因由相信不能藉向該經營者查訊取得所尋求的資料，方可向資料持有人查訊。
如某人以不知悉有關資料為理由而沒有回答問題，獲授權人可藉書面要求該人藉法定聲明核實該事實及理由。
獲授權人在行使權力時，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快出示有關當局的授權書文本，以供查閱。
notes: 不正確：第9(1A)(a)條訂明獲授權人可於任何合理時間進入視察對象的業務處所，並非任何時間。
正確：第9(3)(a)及(4)(a)條訂明，獲授權人可要求視察對象讓其取覽任何指明業務紀錄，並在獲授權人指明的限期內及指明的地點交出該等紀錄。
正確：第9(6)條訂明，獲授權人須有合理因由相信不能夠藉向視察對象作出查訊而取得所尋求的資料，方可向資料持有人作出查訊。
正確：第9(10)條訂明，獲授權人可藉書面要求該人在指明的限期內，藉法定聲明核實該事實及理由。
正確：第9(14)條規定獲授權人在行使權力時，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快出示有關當局的授權書文本，以供查閱。

en.q: Regarding the offences for non-compliance with requirements imposed by an authorized person in a routine inspection, which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
Failing to comply with the requirement without reasonable excuse is punishable, on summary conviction, by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
Failing to comply with the requirement with intent to defraud is punishable, on conviction on indictment, by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years.
Knowingly giving an answer false in a material particular, in purported compliance, is punishable on conviction on indictment by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.
An employee of the person on whom the requirement is imposed commits an offence if, with intent to defraud, the employee causes or allows that person to fail to comply.
notes: Correct: section 10(1) and (2)(a) make a person who, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9(3), (5), (9) or (10) liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $200,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year.
Correct: section 10(2)(b) provides, for that offence, a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction.

Correct: section 10(5) and (9)(a) make a person who, with intent to defraud, fails to comply with the requirement liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 7 years.

Correct: section 10(3) and (4)(a) cover a person who knowingly or recklessly gives an answer false or misleading in a material particular in purported compliance, and set a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on indictment.

Correct: section 10(7) makes it an offence for a related person, defined in section 10(11) to include an employee, to cause or allow the obligated person, with intent to defraud, to fail to comply with the requirement.

tc.q: 關於不遵從獲授權人在例行視察中施加的要求的罪行，根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。
無合理辯解而不遵從該要求，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
出於詐騙意圖而不遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
明知而以在要項上屬虛假的回答充作遵從，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
被施加該要求的人的僱員，如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許該人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。
notes: 正確：第10(1)及(2)(a)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而沒有遵從根據第9(3)、(5)、(9)或(10)條施加的要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$200,000及監禁1年。
正確：第10(2)(b)條訂明，就該罪行一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
正確：第10(5)及(9)(a)條訂明，任何人出於詐騙意圖而沒有遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁7年。
正確：第10(3)及(4)(a)條涵蓋任何人明知或罔顧而給予在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的回答，充作遵從該要求，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
正確：第10(7)條訂明，義務人的相關人士（第10(11)條界定為包括其僱員）如出於詐騙意圖而致使或容許義務人沒有遵從該要求，即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(5)至(10)條

en.q: Regarding the offences under the AMLO for contravening a specified provision of Schedule 2, which of the following are correct?
statements: A financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
A financial institution that, with intent to defraud any relevant authority, contravenes a specified provision is liable on summary conviction to a $500,000 fine and 6 months' imprisonment.
A person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution, causes it to contravene a specified provision commits an offence.
An employee charged with causing the institution, with intent to defraud, to contravene a specified provision has a defence if he or she proves following its compliance policies and procedures.
A fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence of contravening a specified provision is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.
notes: Correct: section 5(5)(a) makes a financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
Incorrect: section 5(6)(b) provides for a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on summary conviction, not 6 months.

Correct: section 5(8) covers a person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution or any relevant authority, causes or permits it to contravene a specified provision.

Incorrect: section 5(9) gives this defence only in proceedings for an offence under section 5(7), knowingly causing or permitting a contravention; it does not extend to the offence of doing so with intent to defraud under section 5(8).
Correct: section 5(10) provides that a fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence under the section is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》所訂違反附表2指明的條文的罪行，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
金融機構出於詐騙任何有關當局的意圖而違反指明的條文，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁6個月。
關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該機構的意圖而致使該機構違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪。
僱員被控出於詐騙意圖而致使金融機構違反指明的條文，如證明其作為是按照該機構為確保遵從而設立的政策及程序，即可作免責辯護。
如合夥因被裁定干犯違反指明的條文的罪行而遭判處罰款，該項罰款須以該合夥的資金支付。
notes: 正確：第5(5)(a)條訂明，金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
不正確：第5(6)(b)條訂明，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁1年，並非6個月。
正確：第5(8)條涵蓋關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該金融機構或任何有關當局的意圖，而致使或准許該機構違反指明的條文。
不正確：第5(9)條所訂的免責辯護只適用於就第5(7)條（明知而致使或准許違反）所訂罪行提起的法律程序，並不適用於第5(8)條出於詐騙意圖的罪行。
正確：第5(10)條訂明，如合夥因被裁定干犯該條所訂罪行而遭判處罰款，該項罰款須以該合夥的資金支付。

en.q: Regarding the disciplinary actions a relevant authority may take under the AMLO against a financial institution that contravenes a specified provision, which of the following are correct?
statements: A pecuniary penalty of up to $10,000,000 may be ordered or, if it is greater, up to 3 times the profit the institution gained or the costs it avoided through the contravention.
If the institution fails to comply with an order to take remedial action, it may further be ordered to pay a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $100,000.
The authority may apply to have an order to pay a pecuniary penalty registered in the District Court, so that it is regarded as that court's order for the payment of money.
Any pecuniary penalty that the relevant authority receives under an order made in such disciplinary action must be paid by it into the general revenue.
The powers to order a financial institution to pay a pecuniary penalty or a daily pecuniary penalty are not exercisable in relation to the Government.
notes: Correct: section 21(2)(c) caps the pecuniary penalty at the greater of $10,000,000 or 3 times the amount of the profit gained, or costs avoided, by the institution as a result of the contravention.
Correct: section 21(4) allows a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $100,000 for each day on which the failure continues after the date specified in the order.

Incorrect: section 21(5) provides for registration of the order in the Court of First Instance, after which it is regarded as an order of that Court made within its civil jurisdiction; the District Court is not named.
Correct: section 21(7) requires a relevant authority to pay into the general revenue any pecuniary penalty received by it under an order made under the section.
Correct: section 21(9) provides that the powers specified in subsections (2)(c) and (4) are not exercisable in relation to the Government.

tc.q: 關於有關當局根據《打擊洗錢條例》可對違反指明的條文的金融機構採取的紀律行動，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 罰款以$10,000,000與該機構因違反而獲取的利潤或避免的開支的3倍兩者中的較大者為上限。
該機構如沒有遵從飭令採取糾正行動的命令，有關當局可進一步命令其繳付不超逾$100,000的按日罰款。
有關當局可申請在區域法院登記繳付罰款的命令，使該命令視為區域法院就繳付款項作出的命令。
有關當局依據其在紀律行動中作出的罰款命令而收取的任何罰款，均須撥入政府一般收入。
有關當局命令繳付罰款以及命令繳付按日罰款的權力，均不可就政府而行使。
notes: 正確：第21(2)(c)條訂明罰款的最高數額為$10,000,000，或因該項違反而令該機構獲取的利潤或避免的開支的金額的3倍，以金額較大者為準。
正確：第21(4)條訂明，就沒有遵從命令的狀況於指明限期後持續的每一日，有關當局可命令該機構繳付不超逾$100,000的按日罰款。
不正確：第21(5)條訂明，罰款命令是在原訟法庭登記，登記後即視為原訟法庭在其民事司法管轄權範圍內作出的命令，並非區域法院。
正確：第21(7)條規定有關當局須將它依據一項根據該條作出的命令而收取的罰款，撥入政府一般收入。
正確：第21(9)條訂明，第(2)(c)及(4)款指明的權力，不可就政府而行使。

en.q: Regarding the Commissioner's power under the AMLO to revoke or suspend a licence, which of the following are correct?
statements: The Commissioner may exercise the power if of the opinion that any director of a corporate licensee is no longer fit and proper to be associated with its money service business.
Where the licensee operates at domestic premises and an occupant revokes the written consent for authorized persons to enter, the Commissioner must revoke the licence.
The Commissioner may suspend a licence either for a period the Commissioner specifies or until the occurrence of an event that the Commissioner specifies.
A notice informing the licensee of a decision to revoke the licence must state the reasons and also the duration and terms of the revocation.
If the Commissioner revokes or suspends a licence, no licence fee that was paid in respect of the grant or renewal of the licence is to be refunded.
A revoked licence is to be surrendered within the time specified in the notice, and a person who fails to do so is liable on conviction to a fine at level 6.
notes: Correct: section 34(1)(a)(iii)(A) lets the Commissioner act if of the opinion that any director of the corporation is no longer a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's business of operating a money service.
Incorrect: under section 34(1)(b)(i) an occupant's revocation of that consent is a ground on which the Commissioner may revoke or suspend the licence; the Commissioner is not obliged to revoke it.
Correct: section 34(2)(b) allows the Commissioner to suspend the licence for a period specified by the Commissioner or until the occurrence of an event specified by the Commissioner.

Incorrect: section 34(5) requires the duration and terms to be stated for a decision to suspend a licence; for a decision to revoke, the notice must state the time within which the licence is to be surrendered.
Correct: section 34(7) provides that if a licence is revoked or suspended, no licence fee paid in respect of its grant or renewal is to be refunded.
Incorrect: section 34(8) makes a person who does not surrender a revoked licence within the time specified in the notice liable on conviction to a fine at level 5, not level 6.

tc.q: 關於關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的權力，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如關長認為屬法團的持牌人的任何董事不再屬與其經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選，可行使權力。
如持牌人在住宅處所經營，而佔用人撤銷其讓獲授權人進入的書面同意，關長必須撤銷牌照。
關長可在其指明的期間內，或在其指明的某事件發生之前，暫時吊銷有關牌照。
關長撤銷牌照的書面通知，須載有作出決定的理由，並須述明撤銷的持續期及條款。
如牌照遭撤銷或暫時吊銷，已就該牌照的批給或續期繳付的牌照費不予退回。
遭撤銷的牌照須在通知指明的期限內交回關長，違者即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第6級罰款。
notes: 正確：第34(1)(a)(iii)(A)條訂明，如關長認為該法團的任何董事不再屬與該持牌人經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選，可行使有關權力。
不正確：根據第34(1)(b)(i)條，佔用人撤銷該書面同意時，關長「可」撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照，並無規定關長必須撤銷牌照。
正確：第34(2)(b)條訂明，關長可在其指明的期間內或在其指明的某事件發生之前，暫時吊銷牌照。
不正確：第34(5)條規定，須述明持續期及條款的是暫時吊銷牌照的通知；撤銷牌照的通知須述明將牌照交回關長的期限。
正確：第34(7)條訂明，如牌照遭撤銷或暫時吊銷，已就該牌照的批給或續期繳付的牌照費不予退回。
不正確：第34(8)條訂明，沒有在通知指明的期限內將遭撤銷的牌照交回關長的人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款，並非第6級。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(1)至(4)條及第60(2)及(4)條

en.q: Regarding a review by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal of a specified decision, such as a refusal to renew a licence, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person aggrieved by a specified decision made in relation to the person may apply for a review within the period ending 21 days after the notice of it is sent.
The specified authority that made the decision may by order extend the time within which an application for review may be made.
An application for review must be made in writing and must state the grounds on which the person makes the application.
When varying a decision, the Tribunal may make it more onerous than the original, if it is a decision the specified authority had power to make.
For the purposes of proceedings before the Tribunal, matters of fact are to be established on a balance of probabilities.
notes: Correct: section 59(1) lets a person aggrieved by a specified decision made in relation to the person apply for a review within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the person of the decision has been sent.

Incorrect: section 59(2) gives the power to extend the time by order to the Tribunal, which under section 59(3) may do so only after the applicant and the specified authority have had a reasonable opportunity to be heard and if there is good cause.
Correct: section 59(4) requires an application for review to be in writing and to state the grounds for the application.

Correct: section 60(2) allows the decision as varied, or a decision substituted for it, to be any decision, whether more or less onerous, that the specified authority had power to make in respect of the applicant.
Correct: section 60(4) provides that, for the purposes of proceedings before the Tribunal, matters of fact are to be established on a balance of probabilities.

tc.q: 關於打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處對指明決定（例如拒絕將牌照續期的決定）的覆核，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人如因就其作出的指明決定感到受屈，可在告知該決定的通知送出後的21日期間申請覆核。
作出該指明決定的指明當局，可藉命令延展有關的人向審裁處提出覆核申請的限期。
向審裁處提出的覆核申請，須藉書面提出，並須述明該申請所據的理由。
審裁處更改指明決定時，可作出較原決定嚴苛的決定，只要該決定是指明當局本有權作出的。
就在審裁處進行的法律程序而言，任何事實事宜須在相對可能性的衡量下予以確立。
notes: 正確：第59(1)條訂明，任何人如因就其作出的指明決定感到受屈，可在告知該決定的通知送出後的21日期間，向審裁處申請覆核該決定。
不正確：第59(2)條訂明藉命令延展限期的是審裁處；根據第59(3)條，審裁處須在申請人及指明當局均已獲給予合理的陳詞機會，並信納有良好因由後，方可批給延展。
正確：第59(4)條規定覆核申請須藉書面提出，並須述明該申請所據的理由。
正確：第60(2)條訂明，經更改的決定或用以取代的決定，可以是指明當局本有權就申請人作出的任何決定，不論是否較原決定嚴苛或寬鬆。
正確：第60(4)條訂明，就在審裁處進行的法律程序而言，任何事實事宜須在相對可能性的衡量下予以確立。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75條

en.q: A person may apply for a review of a specified decision made in relation to the person, such as an order to pay a pecuniary penalty, within 21 days after the notice of it is sent. Regarding when such a decision takes effect under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: If the person notifies the specified authority in writing, before the 21-day period expires, that no review will be sought, the decision takes effect at the time of that notice.
If, within the 21-day period, the person neither notifies the specified authority that no review will be sought nor applies for one, the decision takes effect when the period expires.
If the person applies for a review within the 21-day period and the Tribunal confirms the decision, the decision takes effect when it is so confirmed.
If the person applies for a review within the 21-day period but later withdraws the application, the decision takes effect when it is withdrawn.
The specified authority may, if it considers it appropriate in the public interest, specify in the notice another time at which the decision is to take effect.
notes: Correct: section 75(1)(a) makes the decision take effect at the time the person notifies the specified authority in writing, before the 21-day period expires, that the person will not apply for a review.

Correct: section 75(1)(b) makes the decision take effect when the 21-day period expires if, within it, the person neither notifies the specified authority that the person will not apply for a review nor applies for one.
Correct: section 75(1)(c)(i) provides that, where a review is applied for within the 21 days, a decision confirmed by the Tribunal takes effect at the time it is so confirmed.
Correct: section 75(1)(c)(iii) provides that, where a review is applied for within the 21 days and the application is withdrawn, the decision takes effect at the time the application is withdrawn.

Correct: section 75(2) lets the specified authority, if it considers it appropriate in the public interest, specify in the notice in respect of the decision another time at which the decision is to take effect.

tc.q: 任何人可在告知指明決定的通知送出後的21日期間，申請覆核就其作出的指明決定（例如繳付罰款的命令）。關於該等決定根據《打擊洗錢條例》的生效時間，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如該人在21日限期屆滿前，藉書面通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，該決定在其如此通知時生效。
如該人在21日限期內既沒有通知指明當局不會申請覆核，亦沒有申請覆核，該決定在該限期屆滿時生效。
如該人在21日限期內申請覆核，而審裁處確認該決定，該決定在如此獲確認時生效。
如該人在21日限期內申請覆核，其後撤回該申請，該決定在該申請被撤回時生效。
有關當局如認為為維護公眾利益而如此行事屬適當，可在決定的通知中指明另一生效時間。
notes: 正確：第75(1)(a)條訂明，如該人在21日限期屆滿前藉書面通知有關指明當局該人不會提出覆核申請，該決定在該人如此通知時生效。
正確：第75(1)(b)條訂明，如該人在21日限期內沒有通知有關當局該人不會提出覆核申請，亦沒有提出覆核申請，該決定在該限期屆滿時生效。
正確：第75(1)(c)(i)條訂明，如該人在21日限期內提出覆核申請，而審裁處確認該決定，該決定在如此獲確認時生效。
正確：第75(1)(c)(iii)條訂明，如該人在21日限期內提出覆核申請，其後撤回該申請，該決定在該申請被撤回時生效。
正確：第75(2)條訂明，有關當局如認為為維護公眾利益就某指明決定如此行事屬適當，可在關乎該決定的通知中，指明另一時間作為該決定生效的時間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第25條

en.q: To which of the following persons do the AMLO's provisions regulating the operation of money service not apply?
statements: An authorized institution, even where the money service it operates is part of its principal business
An authorized insurer, for a money service that is ancillary to the insurer's own principal business
A designated retail payment system's system operator, for a money service ancillary to its business as system operator
A licensed money lender that operates a money service ancillary to the money lender's principal business
A licensed corporation that operates a money service forming part of the corporation's principal business
notes: Correct: section 25(a) names an authorized institution without any condition; the requirement that the money service be ancillary to a business of the person attaches to the persons in paragraphs (b) to (g).
Correct: section 25(c) names an authorized insurer that operates a money service that is ancillary to the insurer's principal business.

Correct: section 25(g) names a system operator or settlement institution of a designated retail payment system that operates a money service that is ancillary to its business as a system operator or settlement institution.

Incorrect: section 25 names the Government, authorized institutions, licensed corporations, authorized insurers, licensed insurance broker companies, licensed individual insurance agents and licensed insurance agencies, SVF licensees, system operators and settlement institutions of designated retail payment systems, and stablecoin licensees; a licensed money lender is not among them.

Incorrect: section 25(b) names a licensed corporation only where the money service it operates is ancillary to the corporation's principal business; a money service forming part of the principal business is not ancillary to it.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》中規管經營金錢服務的條文不適用於下列哪些人？
statements: 認可機構，即使其經營的金錢服務屬其主要業務的一部分
獲授權保險人，而其經營的金錢服務附屬於該保險人本身的主要業務
指定零售支付系統的系統營運者，其金錢服務附屬於其作為系統營運者的業務
經營金錢服務的持牌放債人，而該服務附屬於該放債人的主要業務
經營金錢服務的持牌法團，而該服務屬該法團的主要業務的一部分
notes: 正確：第25(a)條列明認可機構，並無附加任何條件；金錢服務須附屬於其業務的前提，適用於(b)至(g)段所列的人。
正確：第25(c)條列明經營金錢服務的獲授權保險人，前提是該服務附屬於該保險人的主要業務。
正確：第25(g)條列明經營金錢服務的指定零售支付系統的系統營運者或交收機構，前提是該服務附屬於其作為系統營運者或交收機構的業務。
不正確：第25條列明的是政府、認可機構、持牌法團、獲授權保險人、持牌保險經紀公司、持牌個人保險代理及持牌保險代理機構、工具持牌人、指定零售支付系統的系統營運者及交收機構，以及穩定幣持牌人；持牌放債人並不在列。
不正確：第25(b)條只在持牌法團經營的金錢服務附屬於該法團的主要業務的情況下，才將其列入；屬主要業務一部分的金錢服務並非附屬於主要業務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24及46條

en.q: Regarding the meaning of terms used in the AMLO's provisions regulating the operation of money service, which of the following are correct?
statements: For those provisions, a director includes anyone who occupies the position of director, by whatever name that position is called.
An authorized officer is a public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department whom the Commissioner has appointed in writing.
A corporation that controls more than a 25% share of a partnership's capital or profits is, in relation to that partnership, its ultimate owner.
A licence for those provisions includes one deemed granted under section 82, the transitional provision for money changers and remittance agents.
Where a licensee who is an individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person is the licensee's ultimate owner.
notes: Correct: section 24 provides that director includes any person occupying the position of director by whatever name called.

Correct: section 24 defines an authorized officer as a person appointed under section 46, which lets the Commissioner appoint in writing any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department to be an authorized officer.

Incorrect: in relation to a partnership, section 24 defines the ultimate owner as an individual who meets one of its tests, such as being entitled to or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits; a corporation is not an individual.

Correct: section 24 defines licence as a licence granted under section 30 or renewed under section 31, including a licence deemed to have been granted under section 82, which deals with money changers and remittance agents carrying on business before the Ordinance commenced.
Correct: in relation to an individual, section 24 provides that, if the individual is acting on behalf of another person, the ultimate owner means the other person.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》中規管經營金錢服務的條文所用詞語的涵義，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就該等條文而言，董事包括任何擔任董事職位的人，不論該職位的名稱為何。
獲授權人員是受僱於香港海關、並獲關長藉書面委任的公職人員。
控制某合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的法團，就該合夥而言屬其最終擁有人。
牌照包括根據第82條（貨幣兌換商及匯款代理人的過渡性條文）當作已批給的牌照。
如屬個人的持牌人代表另一人行事，該另一人即屬該持牌人的最終擁有人。
notes: 正確：第24條訂明，董事包括任何擔任董事職位的人，不論職稱為何。
正確：第24條將獲授權人員界定為根據第46條委任的人，而第46條容許關長藉書面委任受僱於香港海關的任何公職人員為獲授權人員。
不正確：就合夥而言，第24條所指的最終擁有人是符合有關說明的個人，例如直接或間接地有權攤分或控制該合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的個人；法團並非個人。
正確：第24條將牌照界定為根據第30條批給或根據第31條續期的牌照，並包括根據第82條當作已批給的牌照；第82條是關於在本條例生效前經營業務的貨幣兌換商及匯款代理人的過渡性條文。
正確：第24條訂明，就個人而言，如該名個人是代表另一人行事，最終擁有人指該另一人。

en.q: Regarding the conditions of a licence to operate a money service, and the form of the licence, under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: On granting a licence to operate a money service, the Commissioner must impose on the licence the conditions that the Commissioner thinks fit.
If the Commissioner imposes a condition on granting a licence, the licensee must be informed by notice in writing within 14 days after the grant.
On renewing a licence, the Commissioner may amend or remove a condition previously imposed, or impose a new one, as the Commissioner thinks fit.
If satisfied that doing so is reasonable in the circumstances, the Commissioner may amend or remove a licensee's existing conditions, or impose new ones.
A new condition imposed on renewal takes effect on the later of the licensee's receipt of the notice and the time the notice specifies.
A licence must specify the name of the licensee's money laundering reporting officer and the period for which the licence is valid.
notes: Incorrect: section 30(5) provides that, on granting a licence, the Commissioner may impose any condition that the Commissioner thinks fit; it confers a power, not a duty to impose conditions.
Incorrect: section 30(6) requires the Commissioner, on imposing a condition, to inform the licensee by notice in writing at the time the licence is granted, not within 14 days after the grant.
Correct: section 31(5) lets the Commissioner, on renewing a licence, amend or remove any condition previously imposed on the licensee, or impose any new condition, that the Commissioner thinks fit.

Correct: section 32(1) lets the Commissioner, in relation to a licence, amend or remove any condition previously imposed, or impose any new condition, if satisfied that it is reasonable to do so in the circumstances.
Correct: section 31(7) makes an imposition of a condition on renewal take effect at the time the notice is received by the licensee, or at the time specified in the notice, whichever is the later.

Incorrect: section 33 requires a licence to specify the premises or correspondence address, to be endorsed with the conditions imposed or amended under section 30, 31 or 32, and to specify the period for which it is valid; the name of a money laundering reporting officer is not among these.

tc.q: 關於根據《打擊洗錢條例》經營金錢服務的牌照的條件，以及牌照的格式，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在批給牌照以經營金錢服務時，關長須對該牌照施加其認為合適的條件。
關長如在批給牌照時施加條件，須在批給牌照後14日內藉書面通知告知有關持牌人。
在將牌照續期時，關長如認為合適，可修改或免除先前施加的牌照條件，或施加新的條件。
關長如信納在有關情況下如此行事屬合理，可就某牌照修改或免除其條件，亦可施加新條件。
續期時新施加的條件，在持牌人接獲通知時與通知指明的時間兩者中較遲者生效。
牌照須指明持牌人所委任的洗錢報告主任的姓名，以及該牌照的有效期。
notes: 不正確：第30(5)條訂明在批給牌照時，關長「可」施加其認為合適的任何條件；這是一項權力，並非必須施加條件的責任。
不正確：第30(6)條規定關長如在牌照上施加條件，須在批給該牌照時藉書面通知告知有關持牌人，並非在批給後14日內。
正確：第31(5)條訂明，在將牌照續期時，關長如認為合適，可修改或免除任何先前對有關持牌人施加的牌照條件，亦可對該持牌人施加新的條件。
正確：第32(1)條訂明，關長如在有關情況下，信納修改或免除先前對持牌人施加的牌照條件屬合理，或信納施加新的條件屬合理，可就有關牌照如此行事。
正確：第31(7)條訂明，續期時施加條件，在有關持牌人接獲通知時或在該通知指明的時間（兩者以較遲者為準）生效。
不正確：第33條規定牌照須指明處所地址或通訊地址、批註有根據第30、31或32條施加或修改的條件，並指明牌照的有效期；洗錢報告主任的姓名並不在列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(3)及(6)條、第54條及第69(1)至(3)條

en.q: A licensee is informed by notice in writing that the Commissioner has decided to revoke its licence. Which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: Before deciding to revoke the licence, the Commissioner had to give the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
The revocation takes effect when the licensee receives the notice, or at the time specified in the notice, whichever is the later.
The decision to revoke the licence is a specified decision, which the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal to review.
Applying for a review does not by itself stay the revocation, but the licensee may apply to the Tribunal for a stay before the review is determined.
If the licensee applies for a stay, the Tribunal must conduct a hearing to determine that application as soon as reasonably practicable.
notes: Correct: section 34(3) provides that the Commissioner may only exercise a power under section 34(1) after giving the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard.

Incorrect: section 34(6) provides that a revocation takes effect at the time specified in the notice under section 34(4); the rule of receipt or the specified time, whichever is the later, applies to licence conditions under sections 30(7), 31(7) and 32(4).

Correct: paragraph (d)(vii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to revoke or suspend a licence under section 34, and section 34(5)(d) requires the notice to state that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of the decision.

Correct: section 69(1) provides that an application for review does not by itself operate as a stay of execution of the specified decision, and section 69(2) lets the applicant apply to the Tribunal for a stay at any time before the review is determined.
Correct: section 69(3) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for a stay, to conduct a hearing to determine the application.

tc.q: 某持牌人接獲書面通知，得悉關長已決定撤銷其牌照。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 關長須先給予該持牌人合理的陳詞機會，方可作出撤銷其牌照的決定。
該項撤銷在持牌人接獲通知時或在通知指明的時間（兩者以較遲者為準）生效。
撤銷牌照的決定屬指明決定，該持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。
提出覆核申請本身不具暫緩執行撤銷決定的效力，但持牌人可在覆核裁定前向審裁處申請暫緩執行。
持牌人如申請暫緩執行，審裁處須在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快進行聆訊，以裁定該申請。
notes: 正確：第34(3)條訂明，關長須先給予有關持牌人合理的陳詞機會，方可根據第34(1)條行使權力。
不正確：第34(6)條訂明，牌照撤銷在第34(4)條所指的通知指明的時間生效；「接獲通知時或通知指明的時間，以較遲者為準」的規定，適用於第30(7)、31(7)及32(4)條所指的牌照條件。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(vii)段涵蓋關長根據第34條撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的決定，而第34(5)(d)條規定通知須提示有關持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。
正確：第69(1)條訂明，提出覆核申請本身並不具有暫緩執行有關指明決定的效力；第69(2)條則容許申請人在審裁處就覆核作出裁定前，隨時向審裁處申請暫緩執行。
正確：第69(3)條規定，審裁處在接獲暫緩執行的申請後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快進行聆訊，以裁定該申請。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)至(4)條

en.q: A magistrate has issued a warrant authorizing an authorized officer to enter and search premises on which an offence of operating a money service without a licence is suspected. Which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: The officer may call on any person to assist the officer in entering and searching the premises the warrant empowers the officer to enter and search.
If any person or thing obstructs the officer in the exercise of those powers, the officer may remove that person or thing by force.
A person found on the premises who appears to the officer able, or likely to be able, to give information relevant to the investigation may be detained until the search ends.
An authorized officer who enters the premises under the warrant must, if required to do so, produce the warrant for inspection.
Obstructing the officer in the exercise of a power that the warrant confers is an offence punishable on conviction by a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months.
notes: Correct: section 47(2)(a) lets an authorized officer authorized under the warrant call on any person to assist the officer in entering and searching the premises that the officer is empowered to enter and search.
Correct: section 47(2)(c) lets the officer remove by force any person or thing obstructing the officer in the exercise of those powers.

Correct: section 47(2)(d) lets the officer detain any person found on the premises who appears to the officer to be, or to be likely to be, able to give information relevant to the investigation of the suspected offence, until the premises have been searched.
Correct: section 47(3) requires an authorized officer who enters any premises under the section to produce the warrant for inspection, if required.

Correct: section 47(4) makes a person who obstructs an authorized officer exercising a power conferred by a warrant or by section 47(2) liable on conviction to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 裁判官已發出手令，授權獲授權人員進入和搜查懷疑有人於其內犯在沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務的罪行的處所。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 該人員可召請任何人協助該人員進入和搜查其獲手令賦權進入和搜查的處所。
如有任何人或物件妨礙該人員行使根據手令獲賦予的權力，該人員可以武力移去該人或物件。
在處所內發現、該人員覺得有能力或相當可能有能力提供攸關調查資料的人，可被扣留至搜查完畢。
根據該手令進入該處所的獲授權人員，在有人提出要求時，須出示該手令供查閱。
妨礙該人員行使手令所授予權力的人，即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。
notes: 正確：第47(2)(a)條訂明，根據手令獲授權的獲授權人員可召請任何人協助該人員進入和搜查如此獲賦權進入和搜查的處所。
正確：第47(2)(c)條訂明，該人員可以武力移去任何妨礙該人員行使該等權力的人或物件。
正確：第47(2)(d)條訂明，在覺得於該處所內發現的某人有能力（或相當可能有能力）提供攸關涉嫌罪行的調查的資料的情況下，該人員可扣留該人，直至該處所搜查完畢為止。
正確：第47(3)條規定，根據該條進入任何處所的獲授權人員在有人提出要求時，須出示有關手令供查閱。
正確：第47(4)條訂明，任何人妨礙獲授權人員行使手令或第47(2)條授予的權力，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(2)至(7)條

en.q: An authorized officer arrests a person without a warrant, having reasonable grounds to suspect that the person is operating a money service without a licence. Which of the following are correct under the AMLO?
statements: On request, the officer who arrested the person must produce evidence of his or her appointment as an authorized officer.
If the officer considers further enquiries necessary, the person must be taken first to a police station and then to a Customs and Excise office.
The person may be held in detention for up to 72 hours before being charged and brought before a magistrate.
The officer may search the place of arrest and its surrounding areas for anything that may be related to the suspected offence.
If the person forcibly resists the arrest, the officer may use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest.
Any search of the arrested person must be carried out by an authorized officer who is of the same sex as that person.
notes: Correct: section 48(2) requires an authorized officer who arrests or detains a person under the section to produce evidence of his or her appointment as an authorized officer, if requested.

Incorrect: section 48(3) requires the arrested person to be taken immediately to a police station or, if in the officer's opinion further enquiries are necessary, first to an office of the Customs and Excise Department and then to a police station; the order is the other way round.
Incorrect: section 48(4) provides that a person, whether arrested or not, must not be detained for more than 48 hours without being charged and brought before a magistrate.

Correct: section 48(6)(a) lets an officer who has arrested a person search the person, or the place at which the person has been arrested and its surrounding areas, for anything that may be related to the suspected offence.
Correct: section 48(5) lets the authorized officer use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest or detention if a person forcibly resists or attempts to evade it.
Correct: section 48(7) provides that a person may be searched only by an authorized officer of the same sex.

tc.q: 獲授權人員有合理理由懷疑某人正在沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務，無需手令而將該人拘捕。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 應要求時，作出拘捕的人員須出示證據，證明其獲委任為獲授權人員。
如該人員認為有需要作進一步查訊，須先將該人帶往警署，然後帶往香港海關辦事處。
該人可被扣留最多72小時，然後才予落案起訴及帶到裁判法院應訊。
該人員可搜查該人被拘捕的地方及其周邊範圍，以搜尋可能關乎涉嫌罪行的任何物件。
如該人強行反抗拘捕，該人員可使用合理所需的武力，以拘捕該人。
對被拘捕的人進行的任何搜查，均須由與該人同一性別的獲授權人員進行。
notes: 正確：第48(2)條規定，根據該條拘捕或扣留任何人的獲授權人員，在有人提出要求時，須出示其獲委任為獲授權人員的證據。
不正確：第48(3)條規定，獲授權人員須立即將被拘捕的人帶往警署；如該人員認為有需要作進一步的查訊，則須先行將該人帶往香港海關辦事處，然後才帶往警署，次序剛好相反。
不正確：第48(4)條訂明，任何人無論已被拘捕與否，均不得被扣留超過48小時而不予落案起訴及帶到裁判法院應訊。
正確：第48(6)(a)條訂明，已根據該條在某地方拘捕任何人的獲授權人員，可搜查該人或該地方及其周邊範圍，以搜尋可能關乎與涉嫌罪行有關的任何物件。
正確：第48(5)條訂明，如任何人強行反抗或企圖逃避拘捕或扣留，獲授權人員可使用合理所需的武力，以拘捕或扣留該人。
正確：第48(7)條訂明，對任何人進行的搜查，只可由與該人性別相同的獲授權人員進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第26條、第45(3)條及第50、51及58條

en.q: Regarding delegation, regulations, guidelines and the amendment of Schedules under the AMLO's provisions on money service operation and on the Review Tribunal, which of the following are correct?
statements: Subject to some exceptions, the Commissioner of Customs and Excise may in writing delegate functions under the Ordinance to public officers employed in the Customs and Excise Department.
Making regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions regulating the operation of money service is a function the Commissioner of Customs and Excise must not delegate.
By notice published in the Gazette, the Commissioner may amend Schedule 3, the Schedule specifying the fees payable under the provisions regulating money service.
By notice published in the Gazette, the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may amend Schedule 4, which has effect with respect to the Review Tribunal.
The guidelines the Commissioner publishes on how the power to order a licensee to pay a pecuniary penalty will be exercised are not subsidiary legislation.
notes: Correct: section 26(1) lets the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, subject to section 26(2), delegate in writing any of his or her functions under the Ordinance to any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department.

Correct: section 26(2) provides that the Commissioner of Customs and Excise must not delegate any of the functions under section 26 or section 51, and section 51 is the power to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of Part 5.
Correct: section 50 provides that the Commissioner may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Schedule 3, which specifies the fees under sections 28, 30, 31 and 35 to 39.

Correct: section 58(1) gives Schedule 4 effect with respect to the Tribunal, and section 58(2) lets the Secretary, whom section 54 defines as the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, amend Schedule 4 by notice published in the Gazette.

Correct: section 45(3) provides that guidelines published under section 45(1), which indicate how the Commissioner proposes to exercise the power to impose a pecuniary penalty referred to in section 43(2)(c), are not subsidiary legislation.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》中規管經營金錢服務及關於覆核審裁處的條文，關於轉授職能、規例、指引及修訂附表，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 除若干例外外，海關關長可藉書面將其在本條例下的職能轉授予受僱於香港海關的公職人員。
為更佳地施行規管經營金錢服務的條文而訂立規例的職能，海關關長不得轉授。
關長可藉憲報公告，修訂指明規管經營金錢服務的條文下須繳付的費用的附表3。
財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告，修訂就覆核審裁處具有效力的附表4。
關長就如何行使命令持牌人繳付罰款的權力而公布的指引，不是附屬法例。
notes: 正確：第26(1)條訂明，除第26(2)條另有規定外，海關關長可藉書面將其在本條例下的職能，轉授予任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員。
正確：第26(2)條訂明，海關關長不得轉授第26條或第51條所指的職能；第51條是為更佳地施行第5部的條文及達致該部的目的而訂立規例的權力。
正確：第50條訂明，關長可藉憲報公告修訂附表3；附表3指明第28、30、31及35至39條所指的費用。
正確：第58(1)條訂明附表4就審裁處具有效力，第58(2)條則訂明局長（第54條界定為財經事務及庫務局局長）可藉憲報公告修訂附表4。
正確：第45(3)條訂明，根據第45(1)條刊登及公布、示明關長擬如何行使第43(2)(c)條所提述的施加罰款權力的指引，不是附屬法例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52及53條

en.q: Regarding the offence of giving false information in connection with a licence application under the AMLO, and the prosecution of offences under its provisions regulating money service, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person who makes a statement false in a material particular in connection with an application to renew a licence commits an offence if reckless as to whether it is false.
The offence of making a false or misleading statement in connection with a licence application can be committed by any person, not only by the applicant.
The offence of making a false or misleading statement also covers one made in an application for approval of a person proposing to become a licensee's director.
A person convicted of making a false or misleading statement in connection with a licence application is liable to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
Proceedings for an offence under the AMLO's provisions regulating money service, other than an indictable offence, may be instituted within 12 months after the offence is committed.
notes: Correct: section 52(1) makes it an offence for a person, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, to make a statement false or misleading in a material particular, knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, it is false or misleading in a material particular.
Correct: section 52(1) applies to any person who, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, makes such a statement; it is not confined to the applicant.

Incorrect: section 52(1) applies to statements made in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence; an application for approval of a proposed director under section 35 is not such an application.
Correct: section 52(3) makes a person who commits an offence under section 52(1) or (2) liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

Incorrect: section 53 lets proceedings for an offence under Part 5, other than an indictable offence, be instituted within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner, not after it is committed.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》所訂在與牌照申請有關連的情況下提供虛假資料的罪行，以及就該條例中規管經營金錢服務的條文所訂罪行提出檢控，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人罔顧陳述是否虛假，而在與牌照續期申請有關連的情況下作出在要項上屬虛假的陳述，即屬犯罪。
在與牌照申請有關連的情況下作出虛假或具誤導性陳述的罪行，任何人均可干犯，不限於申請人。
作出虛假或具誤導性陳述的罪行，亦涵蓋在要求批准某人成為持牌人董事的申請中所作的陳述。
任何人在與牌照申請有關連的情況下作出虛假或具誤導性陳述，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
就規管經營金錢服務的條文所訂罪行（可公訴罪行除外）提出的法律程序，可於罪行發生後12個月內提出。
notes: 正確：第52(1)條訂明，任何人在與要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請有關連的情況下，作出在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的陳述，並知道或罔顧該陳述是否在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性，即屬犯罪。
正確：第52(1)條適用於在與要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請有關連的情況下作出該等陳述的任何人，並不限於申請人。
不正確：第52(1)條適用於在與要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請有關連的情況下作出的陳述；根據第35條要求批准擬任董事的申請並非該等申請。
正確：第52(3)條訂明，任何人犯第52(1)或(2)條所訂罪行，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
不正確：第53條訂明，就第5部所訂罪行（可公訴罪行除外）而提出的法律程序，可於關長發現或知悉有關罪行後12個月內提出，並非自罪行發生起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第54至56條

en.q: Regarding the tribunal that the AMLO establishes to review specified decisions, which of the following are correct?
statements: In English, the tribunal established to review specified decisions is called the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Appeal Tribunal.
Except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, the tribunal consists of a chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury.
The tribunal's chairperson must be a person eligible for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance.
The tribunal's chairperson must not be a public officer, unless he or she is a public officer only by virtue of chairing a board or tribunal established under an Ordinance.
If the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury considers it appropriate, the Secretary may establish additional tribunals for the purposes of any reviews.
notes: Incorrect: section 55(1) establishes the tribunal as the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal; it is a review tribunal, not an appeal tribunal.

Correct: section 56(1) provides that, except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, the Tribunal consists of a chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary, whom section 54 defines as the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury.
Correct: section 56(2)(a) requires the chairperson to be a person who is eligible for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance (Cap. 4).

Correct: section 56(2)(b) requires the chairperson to be a person who is not a public officer or is a public officer by virtue only of being the chairperson of a board or tribunal established under an Ordinance.
Correct: section 55(3) lets the Secretary, if the Secretary considers it appropriate to do so, establish additional tribunals for the purposes of any reviews.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》為覆核指明決定而設立的審裁處，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 為覆核指明決定而設立的審裁處，其中文名稱為「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集上訴審裁處」。
除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由財經事務及庫務局局長委任的一名主席及2名其他成員組成。
審裁處主席須屬具資格根據《高等法院條例》（第4章）第9條獲委任為法官的人。
審裁處主席須不屬公職人員，或僅因擔任根據條例設立的委員會或審裁處的主席而屬公職人員。
財經事務及庫務局局長如認為適當，可為任何覆核的目的，增設其他審裁處。
notes: 不正確：第55(1)條設立的審裁處，中文名稱為「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處」；是覆核審裁處，並非上訴審裁處。
正確：第56(1)條訂明，除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由局長委任的一名主席及2名其他成員組成；第54條將局長界定為財經事務及庫務局局長。
正確：第56(2)(a)條規定，審裁處主席須具資格根據《高等法院條例》（第4章）第9條獲委任為法官。
正確：第56(2)(b)條規定，審裁處主席須不屬公職人員，或僅憑藉根據任何條例設立的委員會或審裁處的主席的身分而屬公職人員。
正確：第55(3)條訂明，局長如認為適當，可為任何覆核的目的而增設審裁處。

source.en: AMLO s.54 (definition of “specified decision”, paragraph (d)) and s.43(1)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第54條（「指明決定」的定義(d)段）及第43(1)條

en.q: A person aggrieved by a specified decision made in relation to the person may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of it. Which of the following are specified decisions under the AMLO?
statements: The Commissioner's decision, on granting a licence, to impose a condition on the licence
The Commissioner's refusal to approve a person becoming a partner in a partnership that is a licensee
The Commissioner's refusal of a licensee's application to operate a money service at particular premises
A court's order disqualifying a person convicted of operating a money service without a licence from holding one
The Commissioner's decision, on renewing a licence, to amend or remove one of the licence's conditions
The Commissioner's decision to publicly reprimand a licensee that has contravened a condition of its licence
notes: Correct: paragraph (d)(ii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to impose a licence condition under section 30.

Correct: paragraph (d)(x) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to refuse to give approval to a person becoming a partner in a partnership that is a licensee under section 37.

Correct: paragraph (d)(xii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to refuse to grant an application to operate a money service at particular premises under section 39.

Incorrect: the definition of specified decision in section 54 lists decisions of the Monetary Authority, the Securities and Futures Commission, the Insurance Authority, the Commissioner and the Registrar; an order of a court or magistrate disqualifying a person from holding a licence under section 29(3) is not among them.

Incorrect: paragraph (d)(iv) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to amend or impose a licence condition under section 31; a decision to remove a condition is not listed.

Correct: paragraph (d)(xiii) of the definition of specified decision in section 54 covers a decision of the Commissioner to exercise any of the powers under section 43, which include publicly reprimanding a licensee that contravenes any of the conditions of its licence.

tc.q: 任何人如因就其作出的指明決定感到受屈，可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，下列哪些屬指明決定？
statements: 關長在批給牌照時，對所批給的牌照施加條件的決定
關長拒絕給予批准讓某人成為屬持牌人的合夥的合夥人的決定
關長拒絕批准持牌人要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請的決定
法庭取消被裁定無牌經營金錢服務的人持有牌照資格的命令
關長在將牌照續期時，修改或免除該牌照的條件的決定
關長公開譴責違反其牌照的任何條件的持牌人的決定
notes: 正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(ii)段涵蓋由關長作出的根據第30條施加牌照條件的決定。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(x)段涵蓋由關長作出的拒絕根據第37條給予批准讓某人成為屬持牌人的合夥的合夥人的決定。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(xii)段涵蓋由關長作出的拒絕根據第39條批准要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請的決定。
不正確：第54條「指明決定」的定義列出的是金融管理專員、證監會、保監局、關長及處長作出的決定；法庭或裁判官根據第29(3)條作出的取消持有牌照資格的命令並不在列。
不正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(iv)段涵蓋由關長作出的根據第31條修改或施加牌照條件的決定；免除條件的決定並不在列。
正確：第54條「指明決定」定義的(d)(xiii)段涵蓋由關長作出的行使第43條所指的任何權力的決定，而該等權力包括公開譴責違反其牌照的任何條件的持牌人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第54條、第59(5)條、第60(1)及(3)條及第61(1)條

en.q: Regarding how the Review Tribunal deals with an application for review of a specified decision under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: As soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for review, the Tribunal must send a copy of it to the specified authority.
The Tribunal may determine a review by sending the matter back to the specified authority, together with any directions it considers appropriate.
Oral evidence, written statements or documents that the Tribunal receives and considers must be material that would be admissible in a court of law.
The Tribunal may order a person not to publish or otherwise disclose any material that the Tribunal receives for the purposes of the review.
The Tribunal may exercise its powers for the purposes of a review on its own initiative, not only on a party's application.
In reviewing a specified decision, the Tribunal must give the parties, namely the specified authority and the applicant, a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
notes: Correct: section 59(5) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for review, to send a copy of the application to the specified authority.
Correct: section 60(1)(b) lets the Tribunal determine a review by remitting the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate.

Incorrect: section 61(1)(a) lets the Tribunal receive and consider any material by way of oral evidence, written statements or documents, whether or not the material would be admissible in a court of law.
Correct: section 61(1)(g) lets the Tribunal, for the purposes of a review, order a person not to publish or otherwise disclose any material the Tribunal receives.
Correct: section 61(1) lets the Tribunal exercise its powers for the purposes of a review on its own initiative or on the application of any party to the review.

Correct: section 60(3) requires the Tribunal, in reviewing a specified decision, to give the parties to the review a reasonable opportunity to be heard, and section 54 defines the parties as the specified authority that made the decision and the person who makes the application for review.

tc.q: 關於覆核審裁處根據《打擊洗錢條例》處理要求覆核指明決定的申請，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處在接獲覆核申請後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快將該申請的複本送交指明當局。
審裁處可藉將有關事宜發還指明當局處理，並附上它認為適當的指示，對覆核作出裁定。
審裁處收取及考慮的口述證供、書面陳述或文件，須屬在法院中可獲接納為證據的材料。
審裁處可命令任何人不得發表或以其他方式披露審裁處為覆核的目的而收取的任何材料。
審裁處為某項覆核的目的，可主動行使其權力，並不限於應覆核任何一方的申請才行使。
審裁處在覆核某指明決定時，須給予覆核的各方，即指明當局及申請人，合理的陳詞機會。
notes: 正確：第59(5)條規定，審裁處在接獲覆核申請後，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快將該申請的複本送交指明當局。
正確：第60(1)(b)條訂明，審裁處可將有關事宜連同它認為適當的任何指示發還有關指明當局處理，以對覆核作出裁定。
不正確：第61(1)(a)條訂明，審裁處可收取及考慮以口述證供、書面陳述或文件提供的材料，不論該等材料在法院中是否可獲接納為證據。
正確：第61(1)(g)條訂明，審裁處為某項覆核的目的，可命令任何人不得發表或以其他方式披露審裁處所收取的任何材料。
正確：第61(1)條訂明，審裁處為某項覆核的目的，可主動或應覆核的任何一方的申請行使其權力。
正確：第60(3)條規定，審裁處在覆核某指明決定時，須給予覆核各方合理的陳詞機會；第54條將覆核各方界定為作出有關指明決定的指明當局及提出有關覆核申請的人。

en.q: Regarding offences, contempt and compelled evidence in connection with proceedings before the Review Tribunal under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: A person who, without reasonable excuse, threatens or insults the chairperson or another member of the Tribunal on account of the performance of their functions commits an offence.
A person convicted summarily of disrupting a sitting of the Tribunal, without reasonable excuse, is liable to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
A person who, without reasonable excuse, breaches the Tribunal's order prohibiting publication of its determination is liable on indictment to a $1,000,000 fine and 2 years' imprisonment.
The Tribunal has the same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, and must adopt the same standard of proof as that Court in exercising them.
Evidence a witness gives by affidavit on the Tribunal's order is, subject to exceptions, not admissible against the witness in criminal proceedings in a court of law.
notes: Correct: section 61(2)(f) makes it an offence, without reasonable excuse, to threaten, insult or cause any loss to the chairperson or any other member of the Tribunal at any time on account of the performance of the chairperson's or member's functions in that capacity.
Incorrect: section 61(3)(b) provides, for an offence under section 61(2), a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction, not a fine at level 5.

Correct: section 66(3) makes it an offence, without reasonable excuse, to fail to comply with an order under section 66(2) prohibiting the publication or disclosure of the Tribunal's determination, and section 66(4)(a) sets a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment.

Correct: section 63(1) gives the Tribunal the same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, and section 63(3) requires it to adopt the same standard of proof as that Court in exercising those powers.

Correct: section 62(1) and (2) make evidence given in accordance with an order of the Tribunal under section 61(1)(f) to provide evidence by affidavit inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings in a court of law, subject to the exceptions in section 62(3) for offences under section 61(2)(a) or Part V of the Crimes Ordinance.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於與覆核審裁處的法律程序有關的罪行、藐視罪及強迫提供的證據，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 任何人無合理辯解而因審裁處主席或成員執行職能，而威脅或侮辱該主席或成員，即屬犯罪。
無合理辯解而干擾審裁處聆訊使其無法進行的人，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。
沒有合理辯解而違反審裁處禁止發表其裁定的命令的人，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
審裁處懲罰藐視罪者的權力與原訟法庭相同，而在行使該權力時，其舉證準則亦須與原訟法庭所採用的相同。
證人按審裁處的命令以誓章提供的證據，除例外情況外，不得在法院的刑事法律程序中獲接納為針對該證人的證據。
notes: 正確：第61(2)(f)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而因審裁處主席或任何其他成員以主席或成員身分執行職能，而在任何時間威脅或侮辱主席或該成員，或令其蒙受損失，即屬犯罪。
不正確：第61(3)(b)條訂明，任何人犯第61(2)條所訂罪行，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月，並非第5級罰款。
正確：第66(3)條訂明，任何人無合理辯解而沒有遵從審裁處根據第66(2)條作出的禁止發表或披露其裁定的命令，即屬犯罪；第66(4)(a)條訂明，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。
正確：第63(1)條訂明，審裁處在懲罰犯藐視罪者方面所具有的權力與原訟法庭相同；第63(3)條規定審裁處行使該等權力時，須採用原訟法庭行使相同權力時採用的舉證準則。
正確：第62(1)及(2)條訂明，任何人按照審裁處根據第61(1)(f)條作出的以誓章提供證據的命令而提供的證據，不得在法院的刑事法律程序中獲接納為針對該人的證據；第62(3)條就第61(2)(a)條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部所訂罪行訂有例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第64條、第65(2)至(3)條、第66(1)條及第68(2)條

en.q: Regarding costs, and the orders and determinations of the Review Tribunal, under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: Costs the Tribunal awards to a party to the review must be paid by the other party to the review and are recoverable from it as a civil debt.
Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court applies to the award of costs by the Tribunal and to the taxation of any costs it awards.
The provisions on the Review Tribunal do not require an authorized institution acting as banker to an applicant for review to disclose its other customers' affairs.
After completing a review, the Tribunal must, as soon as reasonably practicable, deliver its determination and the reasons for the determination.
Registration in the Court of First Instance makes an order of the Tribunal one that is regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within its jurisdiction.
notes: Correct: section 65(2)(b) provides that costs awarded to a party to the review under section 65(1)(b) must be paid by, and are recoverable as a civil debt from, the other party to the review.
Correct: section 65(3) applies Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court (Cap. 4 sub. leg. A) to the award of costs, and to the taxation of any costs awarded, by the Tribunal under section 65(1).

Correct: section 64 provides that Part 6 and Schedule 4 do not require an authorized institution, acting as the banker or financial adviser of a person who makes an application for review, to disclose information in relation to the affairs of any of its customers other than that person.
Correct: section 66(1)(a) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after completing a review, to deliver its determination and the reasons for the determination.

Correct: section 68(2) provides that an order registered in the Court of First Instance under section 68(1) is to be regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within the jurisdiction of that Court.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於覆核審裁處判給的訟費，以及審裁處的命令及裁定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 審裁處判給覆核某一方的訟費，須由該覆核的另一方支付，並可作為民事債項予以追討。
《高等法院規則》第62號命令適用於審裁處判給訟費，亦適用於所判給訟費的評定。
認可機構如擔任覆核申請人的銀行，有關審裁處的條文並不規定其披露其他客戶事務的資料。
審裁處須在完成覆核後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快宣告其裁定及作出該裁定的理由。
審裁處的命令一經在原訟法庭登記，就所有目的而言，即須視為該法庭在其司法管轄權範圍內作出的命令。
notes: 正確：第65(2)(b)條訂明，如審裁處根據第65(1)(b)條將訟費判給覆核的一方，該訟費須由有關覆核的另一方支付，並可作為民事債項予以追討。
正確：第65(3)條訂明，《高等法院規則》（第4章，附屬法例A）第62號命令適用於審裁處根據第65(1)條判給訟費，亦適用於該等訟費的評定。
正確：第64條訂明，凡某認可機構擔任提出覆核申請的人的銀行或財務顧問，第6部及附表4並不規定該機構披露該人以外的該機構客戶的事務的資料。
正確：第66(1)(a)條規定，審裁處須在完成覆核後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快宣告其裁定及作出該裁定的理由。
正確：第68(2)條訂明，就所有目的而言，根據第68(1)條在原訟法庭登記的命令，須視為原訟法庭在其司法管轄權範圍內作出的命令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第70(1)條、第71(1)至(3)條及第72(2)條

en.q: Regarding an appeal to the Court of Appeal against a determination of the Review Tribunal, and stays of the determination, under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: A party to the review who is dissatisfied with the determination may appeal to the Court of Appeal on a question of fact, but only with that Court's leave.
Leave to appeal to the Court of Appeal against a determination of the Tribunal may be granted by the Tribunal that made the determination.
Leave to appeal may be granted by the Court of Appeal in respect of a particular issue that arises out of the Tribunal's determination.
If the Court of Appeal substitutes another determination, it may be more onerous than the Tribunal's, provided the Tribunal had power to make it.
At any time after the Tribunal has determined a review, a party to the review may apply to the Tribunal for a stay of execution of the determination.
notes: Correct: section 71(1) lets a party to a review who is dissatisfied with the determination appeal to the Court of Appeal on a question of law, a question of fact or a question of mixed law and fact, and section 71(2) bars an appeal unless the Court of Appeal has granted leave.
Incorrect: section 71(2) provides that no appeal may be made unless leave to appeal has been granted by the Court of Appeal; the Tribunal does not grant leave.
Correct: section 71(3)(a) provides that leave to appeal may be granted in respect of a particular issue arising out of the determination.

Correct: section 72(2) allows a determination that the Court of Appeal substitutes to be any determination, whether more or less onerous than the one substituted, that the Tribunal had power to make in respect of the review in question.
Correct: section 70(1) lets a party to a review, at any time after the determination of the review by the Tribunal, apply to the Tribunal for a stay of execution of the determination.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，關於針對覆核審裁處的裁定向上訴法庭提出上訴，以及暫緩執行該裁定，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 覆核的一方如對裁定感到不滿，可就事實問題向上訴法庭提出上訴，但須已獲上訴法庭批予上訴許可。
針對審裁處的裁定向上訴法庭提出上訴的許可，可由作出該裁定的審裁處批予。
上訴法庭可就在審裁處的裁定中出現的某特定爭論點，批予針對該裁定的上訴許可。
上訴法庭以其他裁定取代審裁處的裁定時，取代的裁定可較原裁定嚴苛，只要審裁處本有權作出該裁定。
在審裁處就覆核作出裁定後，覆核的任何一方可隨時向審裁處申請暫緩執行該裁定。
notes: 正確：第71(1)條訂明，覆核的任何一方如對裁定感到不滿，可就法律問題或事實問題或法律兼事實問題向上訴法庭提出上訴；第71(2)條規定須已獲上訴法庭批予上訴許可。
不正確：第71(2)條訂明，除非上訴法庭已批予上訴許可，否則任何人不得提出上訴；批予許可的並非審裁處。
正確：第71(3)(a)條訂明，上訴許可可就在有關裁定中出現的某特定爭論點而批予。
正確：第72(2)條訂明，上訴法庭用以取代的裁定，可以是審裁處本有權就有關覆核作出的任何裁定，不論是否較被取代的裁定嚴苛或寬鬆。
正確：第70(1)條訂明，在審裁處就覆核作出裁定後，該覆核的任何一方可隨時向審裁處提出申請，要求暫緩執行該裁定。

en.q: Regarding the AMLO's preliminary provisions on its short title, its interpretation, its application to the Government and immunity from civil liability, which of the following are correct?
statements: The Ordinance may be cited by its short title, the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance.
The Ordinance applies to the Government except as otherwise expressly provided, and the interpretation provisions in Schedule 1 apply to it in accordance with their terms.
A relevant authority is immune from civil liability for anything it does or omits in performing, or purporting to perform, a function under the Ordinance.
The immunity leaves unaffected any liability of the Government for a thing done or omitted by a public officer in performing, or purporting to perform, the relevant function.
notes: Incorrect: section 1(1), as amended in 2018, provides that the Ordinance may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance; “(Financial Institutions)” is not part of its short title.

Correct: section 3 provides that the Ordinance applies to the Government, except as otherwise expressly provided, and section 2(1) that Schedule 1 contains interpretation provisions that apply to the Ordinance in accordance with their terms.

Incorrect: section 4(1) protects a relevant authority only for anything done or omitted to be done in good faith in the performance or purported performance of such a function; an act not done in good faith is not protected.

Correct: section 4(2) provides that the protection conferred by section 4(1) does not affect any liability of the Government for the thing done or omitted to be done by a public officer in the performance or purported performance of the relevant function.

tc.q: 關於《打擊洗錢條例》導言部分有關其簡稱、釋義、對政府的適用及豁免承擔民事法律責任的條文，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 本條例的簡稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集(金融機構)條例》，本條例可以此引稱。
除另有明文規定外，本條例適用於政府；而附表1所載的釋義條文，按照其內容適用於本條例。
有關當局就其執行或本意是執行本條例所賦予的職能時作出的任何作為或不作為，均獲豁免承擔民事法律責任。
就公職人員在執行或本意是執行有關職能時的作為或不作為，政府所負的任何法律責任，不因有關豁免而受影響。
notes: 不正確：第1(1)條（經2018年修訂）訂明本條例可引稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》；簡稱並無「(金融機構)」字樣。
正確：第3條訂明，除另有明文規定外，本條例適用於政府；第2(1)條訂明，附表1所載釋義條文，按照其內容適用於本條例。
不正確：第4(1)條只就有關當局在執行或本意是執行該等職能時「真誠地」作出的作為或不作為，豁免其民事法律責任；並非真誠作出的作為不受保護。
正確：第4(2)條訂明，如任何公職人員在執行或本意是執行有關職能時作出任何作為或有任何不作為，第4(1)條所賦予的保護，並不影響政府就該作為或不作為而招致的法律責任。
