正確：第7.15段指「內部報告應包括有關客戶的充分詳情，以及導致產生懷疑的全部資料」。
不正確：第7.16段把這項工作交予洗錢報告主任：「洗錢報告主任必須確認收到內部報告，並提醒報告的職員於內部報告後在責任上不可作出通風報訊的事宜」。
正確：第7.13段指金錢服務經營者的法律責任是在合理範圍內盡快作出報告，「故報告流程應盡可能縮短」，「從而確保報告能迅速、保密及無障礙地送交洗錢報告主任」。
不正確：第7.9段列出的主要職能是監督覆核所有內部披露及例外情況報告、備存該等內部覆核的紀錄，以及提供如何避免通風報訊的導引；批核與高風險客戶的業務關係並不在其中。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17(b)至(c)、7.19、7.20及7.24段

en.q: Regarding the MLRO's evaluation of an internal report, the timing of an STR and its receipt by the JFIU, which of the following are correct?
statements: When an MLRO evaluates an internal report, he may look at any previous patterns of instructions, the length of the business relationship, and CDD and ongoing monitoring information and documentation.
In evaluating an internal report, the MLRO may question the customer appropriately, per the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions recommended by the JFIU.
Depending on when knowledge or suspicion arises, an STR may be made before a suspicious transaction occurs, whether or not the intended transaction ultimately takes place.
Where an MLRO decides not to file an STR, it is vital that he keeps proper records of the deliberations and actions taken, to demonstrate that he has acted in a reasonable manner.
Where an MSO has made an STR under section 25A of the DTROP and the OSCO or under section 12 of the UNATMO, the JFIU will acknowledge its receipt of the report.
notes: Correct: ¶7.17(b) says the MLRO's evaluation may include “making reference to any previous patterns of instructions, the length of the business relationship, and CDD and ongoing monitoring information and documentation”.
Correct: ¶7.17(c) lists “appropriate questioning of the customer per the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions recommended by the JFIU”.

Correct: ¶7.19 says “an STR may be made either before a suspicious transaction or activity occurs (whether the intended transaction ultimately takes place or not), or after a transaction or activity has been completed”.
Correct: ¶7.20 says “It is however vital for the MLRO to keep proper records of the deliberations and actions taken to demonstrate he has acted in reasonable manner.”
Correct: ¶7.24 says “The JFIU will acknowledge receipt of an STR made by an MSO under section 25A of both the DTROP and the OSCO, and section 12 of the UNATMO.”

tc.q: 關於洗錢報告主任評估內部報告、提交可疑交易報告的時間及財富情報組確認收到報告，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 評估內部報告時，洗錢報告主任可參考任何先前的客戶指示模式、業務關係年期，以及有關的盡職審查及持續監察資料和文件。
評估內部報告時，洗錢報告主任的工作可包括按照財富情報組推薦的有系統方法來適當地查問客戶，藉以識別可疑交易。
視乎何時得悉或出現可疑情況，金錢服務經營者可在可疑交易發生前提交可疑交易報告，而不論擬作的交易最終有否成事。
洗錢報告主任決定不提交可疑交易報告時，最重要的是他必須將其慎重考慮和採取的行動妥為備存紀錄，以證明他是以合理的方式行事。
根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》或《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》提交的可疑交易報告，財富情報組會確認收到。
notes: 正確：第7.17(b)段指洗錢報告主任的評估可包括「參考任何先前的客戶指示模式、業務關係年期及盡職審查及持續監察資料和文件」。
正確：第7.17(c)段列出「按照財富情報組推薦的有系統方法來適當地查問客戶，藉以識別可疑交易」。
正確：第7.19段指金錢服務經營者「可在可疑交易或活動發生前提交可疑交易報告（而不論該擬作交易最終有否成事）」，亦可在交易或活動完成後作出披露。
正確：第7.20段指「最重要的是洗錢報告主任必須將他們的慎重考慮和採取的行動妥為備存紀錄，證明他們是以合理的方式行事」。
正確：第7.24段指財富情報組會確認收到金錢服務經營者根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條，以及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12條提交的可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10及7.11段

en.q: Regarding how an MSO equips its staff to recognise suspicious transactions and responds to red flag indicators, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO should provide sufficient guidance to its staff and agents (if applicable) to enable them to form suspicion or recognise the signs when ML/TF/PF is taking place.
The guidance should take into account the nature of the transactions and customer instructions staff are likely to encounter, the type of product or service and the means of delivery.
While each individual red flag indicator may not be sufficient to establish an ML/TF/PF activity, a combination of several situations may be indicative of a suspicious transaction.
Detecting any relevant red flag should prompt further investigations, and be a catalyst towards at least initial enquiries about the source of funds and a request for additional CDD documents.
Where applicable, an MSO may adopt the “SAFE” approach promoted by the JFIU, which includes screening the account for suspicious indicators and asking the customer appropriate questions.
The steps of the “SAFE” approach that an MSO may adopt include finding out the customer's records and then filing an STR with the JFIU on what has been found.
notes: Correct: ¶7.10 says “An MSO should provide sufficient guidance to its staff and agents (if applicable) to enable them to form suspicion or to recognise the signs when ML/TF/PF is taking place.”

Correct: ¶7.10 says “The guidance should take into account the nature of the transactions and customer instructions that staff is likely to encounter, the type of product or service and the means of delivery.”
Correct: ¶7.10 says “While each individual indicator may not be sufficient to establish an ML/TF/PF activity, a combination of several situations may be indicative of a suspicious transaction.”

Correct: ¶7.10 says the detection of any relevant red flag “should prompt further investigations and be a catalyst towards making at least initial enquiries about the source of funds and requesting additional documentary support for CDD”.

Correct: ¶7.11 says an MSO may adopt, where applicable, the “SAFE” approach promoted by the JFIU, which includes “(a) screening the account for suspicious indicators; (b) asking the customers appropriate questions”.
Incorrect: ¶7.11 lists “(c) finding out the customer's records” and, as step (d), evaluating all of the information so gathered; filing an STR is not a step of the “SAFE” approach.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者如何協助職員辨別可疑交易及回應可疑交易指標，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應為職員及代理人（如適用）提供充足導引，讓他們在發生洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集情況時能產生懷疑或辨別出來。
金錢服務經營者為職員提供的導引，應顧及職員可能遇到的交易及客戶指示性質、產品或服務類別及交付方式。
雖然個別的風險指標或未足以確立洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動，但如不同情況一併出現，則顯示可能有可疑交易。
一旦偵察到任何相關的可疑交易訊號，應及時作進一步調查，這至少可促使對資金來源作出初步查詢，並要求提供更多盡職審查的證明文件。
金錢服務經營者可按情況採用財富情報組所推廣的「SAFE」方法，其中包括篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標及向客戶作出恰當提問。
金錢服務經營者可採用的「SAFE」方法，包括翻查客戶的已知紀錄，然後就所得結果向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。
notes: 正確：第7.10段指「金錢服務經營者應為職員及代理人（如適用）提供充足導引，讓職員在發生洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集情況時即產生懷疑或能將有關情況辨別出來」。
正確：第7.10段指「有關導引應顧及職員可能遇到的交易及客戶指示性質、產品或服務類別及交付方式」。
正確：第7.10段指「雖然個別的風險指標或未足以確立洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動，但如不同情況一併出現，則顯示可能有可疑交易」。
正確：第7.10段指金錢服務經營者一旦偵察到任何相關的可疑交易訊號，「應及時作進一步調查，這至少可促使對有關資金來源作出初步查詢，並要求提供更多關於盡職審查的證明文件」。
正確：第7.11段指金錢服務經營者可按情況採用財富情報組所推廣的「SAFE」方法，其中包括「(a)篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標；(b)向客戶作出恰當提問」。
不正確：第7.11段列出的是「(c)翻查客戶的已知紀錄；及(d)根據以上資料評估客戶的交易是否可疑」；提交可疑交易報告並非「SAFE」方法的步驟。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)段

en.q: Which of the following are among the illustrative red flag indicators of transactions which do not make economic sense?
statements: Transactions that cannot be reconciled with the usual activities of the customer, or that are incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer
“Structuring” or “smurfing”, that is, one or a few large transactions being conducted when many lower value transactions could have been used instead
Frequent or several transactions, each by itself below the CDD thresholds, executed to conceal or disguise significant transactions and avoid disclosure for record purposes
Substantial increases in the number, frequency or amounts of a customer's transactions, especially if remittances are made to a destination or person not normally associated with the customer
A lack of apparent relationship between the originator and the recipient of funds, or personal remittances to jurisdictions with no apparent family or business link to the customer
A customer who has no relation to the jurisdiction where he sends or receives the money, even though he can sufficiently explain why the money is sent to or received from there
notes: Correct: ¶7.10(a)(i) lists “transactions that cannot be reconciled with the usual activities of the customer”, and (a)(ii) transactions “incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer in question”.
Incorrect: ¶7.10(a)(iv) describes structuring or smurfing the other way round: “many lower value transactions conducted when one, or a few, large transactions could be used”.

Correct: ¶7.10(a)(iii) lists concealing or disguising significant transactions “to avoid disclosure for record purpose by executing frequent or several transactions such that each transaction by itself is below CDD thresholds”.
Incorrect: ¶7.10(a)(vii) lists such increases where they occur “without apparent cause”; that qualifier has been dropped.

Correct: ¶7.10(a)(ix) lists “a lack of apparent relationship between the originator and the recipient of funds, and/or personal remittances sent to jurisdictions that have no apparent family or business link to customer”.

Incorrect: ¶7.10(a)(ix) lists a customer who has no relation to the jurisdiction and “cannot sufficiently explain why money is sent to/received from there”; a customer who can explain it is not the case listed.

tc.q: 下列哪些屬於「不合乎經濟原則的交易」的可疑交易指標示例？
statements: 不符合客戶慣常活動的交易，或不符合金錢服務經營者對有關客戶的認知和經驗的交易
「分拆整合」或「化整為零」，即當款項可分成多項小額交易進行時，有關款項卻以一次過或數次大額交易進行
執行頻繁或分數次的交易，令每宗交易款額低於盡職審查門檻，從而隱藏或掩飾重大交易，規避披露資料作紀錄用途
客戶的交易數量、頻密程度或交易款額大幅上升，尤其是向通常與客戶沒有關連的目的地或人士匯款
款項的匯款人與收款人沒有明顯關係，或向與客戶沒有明顯家族或業務連繫的司法管轄區進行個人匯款
客戶與其匯款或收款的司法管轄區沒有關係，但能夠充分解釋匯出或匯入款項的原因
notes: 正確：第7.10(a)(i)段列出「交易不符合客戶的慣常活動」，第7.10(a)(ii)段列出「交易不符合金錢服務經營者對客戶的認知和經驗」。
不正確：第7.10(a)(iv)段所述的情況剛好相反：「當大額款項交易可一次過或只需數次進行時，有關款項卻分成多項小額進行交易」。
正確：第7.10(a)(iii)段列出「執行頻繁的交易或分數次進行交易，令每宗交易款額低於盡職審查門檻，從而隱藏或掩飾重大交易，規避披露資料作紀錄用途」。
不正確：第7.10(a)(vii)段所列的是交易數量／頻密程度／交易款額大幅上升「而沒有明顯原因」的情況；所述遺漏了這項限制。
正確：第7.10(a)(ix)段列出「款項的匯款人與收款人沒有明顯關係，及／或向與客戶沒有明顯家族或業務連繫的司法管轄區進行個人匯款」。
不正確：第7.10(a)(ix)段所列的是客戶與有關司法管轄區沒有關係，「並且未能充分解釋為何向該地匯出／從該地匯入款項」的情況，而非能夠充分解釋的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)段

en.q: Which of the following are among the illustrative red flag indicators of cash intensive transactions with abnormal patterns?
statements: Frequent transactions of large cash amounts that do not appear to be justified by the customer's business activity or background
Customers making large and/or frequent remittances to individuals and companies, whether or not these are associated with their business
Numerous transactions by a customer over a short period of time, where each is above the CDD threshold and the cumulative total is substantial
Customers who together and simultaneously use separate branches to conduct large (cash) transactions, or whose transactions involve counterfeit notes
notes: Correct: ¶7.10(b)(i) lists “frequent transactions of large cash amounts that do not appear to be justified by the customer's business activity or background”.
Incorrect: ¶7.10(b)(ii) lists such remittances where they go “mostly to individuals and companies not normally associated with their business”, not remittances to recipients of every kind.

Incorrect: ¶7.10(b)(iv) lists numerous transactions where “the amount of each transaction is below the CDD threshold or not substantial, but the cumulative total of which is substantial or exceeds the threshold”.

Correct: ¶7.10(b)(v) lists “customers who together, and simultaneously, use separate branches to conduct large (cash) transactions”, and (b)(vi) “customers whose transactions involve counterfeit notes or forged instruments”.

tc.q: 下列哪些屬於「模式異常的現金密集型交易」的可疑交易指標示例？
statements: 客戶進行頻繁、大額的現金交易，而從客戶業務活動或客戶背景看來無法解釋
客戶進行大額及／或頻繁的匯款，而不論收款的個人及公司是否與其業務有關連
客戶在短時間內進行多宗交易，每宗交易的款額均高於盡職審查門檻，而累積總額龐大
多名客戶一起在同一時間使用不同的分行處理大額（現金）交易，或客戶的交易涉及偽鈔
notes: 正確：第7.10(b)(i)段列出「從客戶業務活動或客戶背景看來無法解釋的頻繁、大額現金交易」。
不正確：第7.10(b)(ii)段所列的是「大多匯給與其業務通常沒有關連的個人及公司」的大額及／或頻繁匯款，並非不論收款人是誰。
不正確：第7.10(b)(iv)段所列的是「每宗交易的款額均低於盡職審查門檻或數額不大，但累積總額龐大或超過盡職審查門檻」的多宗交易，而非每宗均高於門檻。
正確：第7.10(b)(v)段列出「多名客戶一起在同一時間使用不同的分行處理大額（現金）交易」，第7.10(b)(vi)段列出「客戶的交易涉及偽鈔或偽造工具」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.10(c) and footnotes 62–63
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)段及註腳62至63

en.q: Which of the following are among the illustrative red flag indicators of trade-based related transactions?
statements: The commodity shipped is of a type designated as “higher risk” for ML/TF/PF activities, for example consumer electronics
A payment method inconsistent with the transaction's risk characteristics, e.g. an advance payment to a new supplier in a low-risk jurisdiction
Significant discrepancies between the description of the commodity on the bill of lading or invoice and the commodity actually shipped
The transaction involves the use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit, or the use of front (or shell) companies
The size of the shipment or of the commodity appears inconsistent with the scale of the MSO's own regular business activities
Transhipment of the commodity through one or more countries or jurisdictions for which there is no apparent economic reason
notes: Correct: ¶7.10(c)(ii) lists a type of commodity shipped that “is designated as “higher risk” for ML/TF/PF activities”, and footnote 62 gives as an example “high-value, low-volume goods (e.g. consumer electronics)”.
Incorrect: footnote 63 gives as its example “the use of an advance payment for a shipment from a new supplier in a high-risk jurisdiction”, not a low-risk one.
Correct: ¶7.10(c)(iii) lists where “significant discrepancies appear between the description of the commodity on the bill of lading or invoice and the actual commodity shipped”.
Correct: ¶7.10(c)(viii) lists “the use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit”, and (c)(ix) “the use of front (or shell) companies”.
Incorrect: ¶7.10(c)(v) compares the size of the shipment or commodity with “the scale of the exporter or importer's regular business activities”, not the MSO's.
Correct: ¶7.10(c)(x) lists where “the commodity is transhipped through one or more countries or jurisdictions for no apparent economic reason”.

tc.q: 下列哪些屬於「貿易相關的交易」的可疑交易指標示例？
statements: 付運商品被指認為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動「較高風險」的類別，例如消費電子產品
支付方法看似與交易的風險特徵不相稱，例如向位於低風險司法管轄區的新供應商預先繳付貨款
交易所涉的提單或發票上關於商品的說明，與實際付運的商品之間有重大差異
交易涉及使用經反覆修改或頻密延長期限的信用證，或交易涉及使用掛名（或空殼）公司
裝運或所付運商品的大小，看似與金錢服務經營者本身常規業務活動的規模不相稱
商品經一個或多個國家或司法管轄區轉運，而有關轉運並沒有明顯的經濟原因
notes: 正確：第7.10(c)(ii)段列出「付運的商品被指認為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動『較高風險』的類別」，註腳62舉例「價值高、體積小的產品（諸如消費電子）」。
不正確：註腳63所舉的例子是「向高風險司法管轄區的新供應商預繳貨款」，而非低風險司法管轄區。
正確：第7.10(c)(iii)段列出「提單或發票上關於商品的說明與實際付運的商品有重大差異」。
正確：第7.10(c)(viii)段列出「交易涉及使用經反覆修改或頻密延長期限的信用證」，第7.10(c)(ix)段列出「交易涉及使用掛名（或空殼）公司」。
不正確：第7.10(c)(v)段比較的是裝運／商品的大小與「出口商或進口商常規業務活動的規模」，而非金錢服務經營者的業務規模。
正確：第7.10(c)(x)段列出「商品經一個或多個國家或司法管轄區轉運而沒有明顯的經濟原因」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)至(f)段

en.q: Which of the following are listed among the red flag indicators of suspicious transactions and activities?
statements: Account activity or transaction volume that is not commensurate with the customer's known profile, such as age, occupation or income
Transactions with jurisdictions or entities reported to be associated with terrorist activities, or with persons designated as terrorists
Donations to charities or non-profit organisations (NPOs), whichever country or jurisdiction those charities or NPOs are located in
An agent or counterpart conducting many transactions for one customer, with different name spellings, false addresses or an identification that “evolves”
A customer accompanied by others who keep a low profile or stay just outside the premises, or who appears to be in doubt when asked for further details
Multiple customers who seem to be working together to break one transaction into two or more transactions below the threshold, to avoid reporting requirements
notes: Correct: ¶7.10(d)(i) lists account activity or transaction volume that “is not commensurate with the customer's known profile (e.g. age, occupation, income)”.
Correct: ¶7.10(d)(ii) lists “transactions with jurisdictions or entities that are reported to be associated with terrorist activities or with persons that have been designated as terrorists”.

Incorrect: ¶7.10(d)(iv) lists donations to charity or NPOs “located in conflict zones or jurisdictions reported to have terrorist activities / terrorist groups”, not donations to them wherever located.

Correct: ¶7.10(e)(iii) lists, for agents or counterparts of MSOs, a “large volume of transactions for the same customer with multiple instances of using different name spellings, false addresses or an identification that evolves”.
Correct: ¶7.10(f)(i) lists a customer who “is accompanied by others who keep a low profile or stay just outside the premise; or appears to be in doubt when being asked for further details”.

Correct: ¶7.10(f)(iv) lists multiple customers who “appear to be trying to avoid reporting requirements and seem to be working together to break one transaction into two or more transactions below the threshold”.

tc.q: 下列哪些列為可疑交易及活動的指標？
statements: 客戶的帳戶活動或交易量，與已知的客戶狀況（例如年齡、職業、收入）不相稱
交易涉及的司法管轄區或實體，據稱與恐怖主義活動或被指認為恐怖分子的人有關連
向慈善或非牟利團體捐款，有關團體可以位於任何一個國家或司法管轄區
代理人或交易對手為同一客戶進行大量交易，多次使用不同拼寫的名稱、假地址或「演變」的識別資料
客戶由其他人陪同，而陪同人士刻意保持低調或在處所外等候；或客戶被問及更多詳情時顯得猶豫
多名客戶看似試圖規避申報規定，合謀將一項交易拆分為低於申報門檻的兩項或更多的交易
notes: 正確：第7.10(d)(i)段列出「帳戶活動或交易量與已知的客戶狀況（例如年齡、職業、收入）不相稱」。
正確：第7.10(d)(ii)段列出「交易涉及的司法管轄區或實體，據稱與恐怖主義活動或被指認為恐怖分子的人有關連」。
不正確：第7.10(d)(iv)段所列的是向「位於衝突地區或據稱有恐怖主義活動／恐怖組織的司法管轄區」的慈善或非牟利團體捐款，並非向位於任何地方的團體捐款。
正確：第7.10(e)(iii)段就金錢服務經營者的代理人或交易對手列出「為同一客戶進行大量交易，多次使用不同拼寫的名稱、假地址或不斷『演變』的識別資料」。
正確：第7.10(f)(i)段列出「客戶由其他人陪同，而陪同人士刻意保持低調或在處所外等候；或客戶被問及更多詳情時顯得猶豫」。
正確：第7.10(f)(iv)段列出「多名客戶看似試圖規避申報規定，合謀將一項交易拆分為低於申報門檻的兩項或更多的交易」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.21, ¶7.23 and footnote 65
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21及7.23段及註腳65

en.q: Regarding urgent reporting to the JFIU and the quality of the STRs an MSO files, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where urgent reporting is required, for example because a customer has instructed the MSO to move funds or close the account, the MSO should indicate this in the STR.
Where exceptional circumstances exist in relation to an urgent reporting, the MSO must make an initial notification to the JFIU by telephone.
An MSO should ensure that its STRs are of high quality, taking into account the feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and by the CCE from time to time.
The JFIU's quarterly report is written specifically for the MSO sector, and consists of an analysis of STRs and matters of interest and feedback.
The quarterly report sits in a secure area of the JFIU's website, for which an MSO may apply for a login name and password through the registration form or by contacting the JFIU.
notes: Correct: ¶7.21 says that where an urgent reporting is required, e.g. where a customer has instructed the MSO to move funds or other property or close the account, “an MSO should indicate this in the STR”.

Incorrect: ¶7.21 says that where exceptional circumstances exist in relation to an urgent reporting, “an initial notification by telephone to the JFIU should be considered”; it is to be considered, not required.

Correct: ¶7.23 says an MSO should ensure STRs filed to the JFIU are of high quality “taking into account feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and the CCE from time to time”.

Incorrect: footnote 65 says the quarterly report “is relevant to all financial sectors”, so it is not written for MSOs alone; its two parts are “(i) analysis of STRs and (ii) matters of interest and feedback”.

Correct: footnote 65 says the report “is available at a secure area of the JFIU's website”, and that MSOs can apply for a login name and password “by completing the registration form available on the JFIU's website or by contacting the JFIU directly”.

tc.q: 關於向財富情報組作出緊急報告及金錢服務經營者提交的可疑交易報告的水平，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如須作出緊急報告（例如客戶已指示金錢服務經營者移動資金或結束戶口），金錢服務經營者應在可疑交易報告中述明。
如有特殊情況而須向財富情報組作出緊急報告，金錢服務經營者必須先以電話向財富情報組作出初步通知。
金錢服務經營者應留意財富情報組在季度報告及關長不時提供的反饋意見及導引，以確保其可疑交易報告屬高水平。
財富情報組的季度報告是專為金錢服務經營者行業編寫的，分為可疑交易報告的分析及注意事項及反饋意見兩部分。
季度報告可於財富情報組網站的限制區查閱，金錢服務經營者可填妥登記表格或直接聯絡財富情報組申請登入帳戶及密碼。
notes: 正確：第7.21段指如出現須作出緊急報告的情況（例如客戶已指示金錢服務經營者移動資金或其他財產、結束戶口），「金錢服務經營者應在可疑交易報告中述明」。
不正確：第7.21段指如情況特殊而須作出緊急報告，「應考慮初步以電話通知財富情報組」，是應考慮的做法，並非必須。
正確：第7.23段指金錢服務經營者應留意由財富情報組在季度報告及關長不時提供的反饋意見及導引，「以確保向財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告屬高水平」。
不正確：註腳65指季度報告「與金融業各界有關」，並非專為金錢服務經營者而編寫；季度報告分為「(i)可疑交易報告的分析；及(ii)注意事項及反饋意見」兩個部分。
正確：註腳65指「季度報告可於財富情報組網站的限制區查閱」，金錢服務經營者如要申請登入帳戶及密碼，「可填妥於財富情報組網站的登記表格或直接聯絡財富情報組」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.9、7.31、7.32及7.35段

en.q: Regarding court documents and crime-related intelligence requests that an MSO receives from law enforcement agencies, which of the following are correct?
statements: As such court documents are crucial to investigations and to restraining and confiscating illicit proceeds, an MSO should have clear policies and procedures to handle them effectively and in a timely manner.

The policies and procedures for handling court documents should include providing accurate information, allocating sufficient resources and appointing a staff member as the main point of contact with law enforcement agencies.
An MSO must respond to any search warrant and production order within the required time limit, by providing all the information or material within the scope of the court document.

Where an MSO has difficulty in complying with the timeframes stipulated for a search warrant or production order, it should contact the officer-in-charge of the investigation at the earliest opportunity for further guidance.

On receiving a crime-related intelligence request, such as a notification letter, on a particular customer, the MSO should timely assess the risks involved and the need for an appropriate review of the customer.
An MSO served with a court document relating to a particular customer should be aware that the customer to whom the document relates can be a victim of crime.
notes: Correct: ¶7.31 says these court documents “are crucial to aid law enforcement agencies to carry out investigations as well as restrain and confiscate illicit proceeds”, so an MSO should establish clear policies and procedures to handle them “in an effective and timely manner”.

Correct: ¶7.31 says the policies and procedures should include “provision of accurate information, allocation of sufficient resources and appointing a staff as the main point of contact with law enforcement agencies”. This contact is for court documents; ¶7.9 makes the MLRO the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies.

Correct: ¶7.32 says “An MSO must respond to any search warrant and production order within the required time limit by providing all the information or material that fall within the scope of the court document.”

Correct: ¶7.32 says that where an MSO encounters difficulty in complying with the timeframes stipulated, it “should at the earliest opportunity contact the officer-in-charge of the investigation for further guidance”.

Correct: ¶7.35 says that on a crime-related intelligence request (e.g. notification letter) relating to a particular customer, the MSO “should timely assess the risks involved and the need to conduct an appropriate review on the customer or the business relationship”.
Correct: ¶7.35 says the MSO “should also be aware that the customer to whom the court document relates can be a victim of crime”.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者接獲執法機構的法庭文件及與罪行相關的情報要求，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 這類法庭文件對執法機構的調查以至限制及沒收非法得益至為重要，金錢服務經營者應制訂清晰的政策和程序，以有效及合時的方式處理。
金錢服務經營者處理法庭文件的政策和程序，應包括為此提供準確資料、分配足夠資源及委任一名人員作為與執法機構的中央聯絡點。
金錢服務經營者須確保在規定期限內就任何搜查令及提交令作出回應，提供一切屬該等法庭文件範圍內的資料或材料。
金錢服務經營者在遵守搜查令或提交令的規定時限方面如遇到困難，應第一時間聯絡調查的主管人員，尋求進一步導引。
如接獲執法機構就特定客戶發出與罪行相關的情報要求（例如通知書），金錢服務經營者應適時評估所涉風險及是否需要進行適當覆核。
金錢服務經營者接獲執法機構就特定客戶送達的法庭文件時，應留意法庭文件所涉的客戶，或是罪案的受害人。
notes: 正確：第7.31段指這類法庭文件「對於協助執法機構進行調查，以至限制及沒收非法得益，至為重要」，因此金錢服務經營者應就如何「以有效及合時的方式」處理這類法庭文件，制訂清晰的政策和程序。
正確：第7.31段指有關政策和程序應「包括為此提供準確資料、分配足夠資源及委任一名人員作為與執法機構的中央聯絡點」。這是處理法庭文件的聯絡人；第7.9段則指洗錢報告主任是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點。
正確：第7.32段指「金錢服務經營者須確保在規定期限內就任何搜查令及提交令作出回應，做法是提供一切屬該等法庭文件範圍內的資料或材料」。
正確：第7.32段指金錢服務經營者在遵守規定時限方面如遇到困難，「應第一時間聯絡調查的主管人員，尋求進一步導引」。
正確：第7.35段指如接獲執法機構就特定客戶發出與罪行相關的情報要求（例如通知書），金錢服務經營者「便應適時評估所涉風險，並應評估是否需要對該客戶或業務關係進行適當覆核」。
正確：第7.35段指金錢服務經營者「應留意法庭文件所涉的客戶，或是罪案的受害人」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.33至7.34段

en.q: Regarding restraint orders, confiscation orders and the forfeiture of terrorist property, which of the following are correct?
statements: During a law-enforcement investigation, an MSO may be served with a restraint order, which prohibits dealing with particular funds or property pending the outcome of the investigation.
On being served with a restraint order during an investigation, an MSO must make sure that it can withhold the relevant property that is the subject of the order.
A restraint order may not apply to all the funds or property in a business relationship, and the MSO should consider what, if any, may be utilised subject to the law of Hong Kong.

Once a defendant has been charged, a court may order the confiscation of his criminal proceeds, and an MSO holding funds deemed to represent his benefit from the crime may be served with a confiscation order.
Besides ordering the confiscation of a defendant's criminal proceeds, a court may also order the forfeiture of property where it is satisfied that the property is terrorist property.
notes: Correct: ¶7.33 says an MSO may be served with a restraint order during a law-enforcement investigation, “which prohibits the dealing with particular funds or property pending the outcome of an investigation”.
Correct: ¶7.33 says “The MSO must ensure that it is able to withhold the relevant property that is the subject of the order.”

Correct: ¶7.33 says the restraint order “may not apply to all funds or property involved within a particular business relationship and the MSO should consider what, if any, funds or property may be utilised subject to the law of Hong Kong”.
Incorrect: ¶7.34 says a court may order the confiscation of criminal proceeds “upon the conviction of a defendant”, not once he has been charged.
Correct: ¶7.34 says “A court may also order the forfeiture of property where it is satisfied that the property is terrorist property.”

tc.q: 關於限制令、沒收令及充公恐怖分子財產，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 在執法調查期間，金錢服務經營者可能會收到限制令，禁止在調查結果出來之前處理某些資金或財產。
金錢服務經營者在執法調查期間收到限制令後，必須確保它能夠扣留該限制令涉及的相關財產。
限制令不一定適用於某業務關係中的全部資金或財產，金錢服務經營者應考慮根據香港法例可動用哪些資金或財產（如有）。
被告一經落案起訴，法院可下令沒收其犯罪所得，而持有法院認為代表其犯罪得益的資金的金錢服務經營者，可能會收到沒收令。
除下令沒收被告的犯罪所得外，如法院信納某些財產屬恐怖分子財產，亦可下令充公有關財產。
notes: 正確：第7.33段指在執法調查期間，金錢服務經營者可能會收到限制令，「禁止在調查結果出來之前處理某些資金或財產」。
正確：第7.33段指「金錢服務經營者必須確保它能夠扣留該限制令涉及的相關財產」。
正確：第7.33段指「該限制令不一定適用於某業務關係中涉及的全部資金或財產，而金錢服務經營者應考慮根據香港法例，可動用哪些資金或財產（如有）」。
不正確：第7.34段指「被告一經定罪」，法院才可下令沒收其犯罪所得，並非在被告被起訴時。
正確：第7.34段指「如法院信納某些財產屬恐怖分子財產，亦可下令充公有關財產」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.1至8.2段

en.q: Regarding the purposes of record-keeping and the standards an MSO's records should meet, which of the following are correct?
statements: Record-keeping forms an essential part of the audit trail by which criminal or terrorist property or funds are detected, investigated and confiscated.
Record-keeping helps the investigating authorities establish a suspect's financial profile and trace criminal or terrorist funds, and assists the Court to examine relevant past transactions.
Keeping records lets an MSO demonstrate its compliance with the AMLO, the Guideline and other relevant guidance that the CCE promulgates from time to time.

An MSO should maintain the CDD information, transaction records and other records needed to meet the statutory and regulatory requirements appropriate to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses.
For funds moving through the MSO that relate to any customer and, where appropriate, to that customer's beneficial owner, the MSO should ensure a clear and complete audit trail.
notes: Correct: ¶8.1 says “Record-keeping is an essential part of the audit trail for the detection, investigation and confiscation of criminal or terrorist property or funds.”

Correct: ¶8.1 says record-keeping “helps the investigating authorities to establish a financial profile of a suspect, trace the criminal or terrorist property or funds and assists the Court to examine all relevant past transactions”.

Correct: ¶8.1 says record-keeping “also enables an MSO to demonstrate compliance with the requirements set out in the AMLO, this Guideline and other relevant guidance promulgated by the CCE from time to time”.

Correct: ¶8.2 says an MSO should maintain CDD information, transaction records and other records “that are necessary and sufficient to meet the statutory and regulatory requirements that are appropriate to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses”.

Correct: ¶8.2(a) has the MSO ensure that “the audit trail for funds moving through the MSO that relate to any customer and, where appropriate, the beneficial owner of the customer, account or transaction is clear and complete”.

tc.q: 關於備存紀錄的目的及金錢服務經營者的紀錄應符合的標準，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者備存的紀錄是審計線索中重要的一環，可藉以偵察、調查及沒收罪犯或恐怖分子的財產或資金。
備存紀錄有助調查當局確定疑犯的財政狀況及追查罪犯或恐怖分子的資金，並協助法院審查相關的過往交易。
金錢服務經營者可藉備存紀錄，證明其符合《打擊洗錢條例》的規定、指引及關長不時公布的其他相關指引。
金錢服務經營者應按業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，保存符合法定及監管規定所需的盡職審查資料、交易紀錄及其他紀錄。
金錢服務經營者應確保經由其提存而與客戶及其實益擁有人（如適用）有關的資金，均有清晰及完備的審計線索。
notes: 正確：第8.1段指「備存紀錄是審計線索中重要的一環，可藉以偵察、調查及沒收罪犯或恐怖分子的財產或資金」。
正確：第8.1段指「備存紀錄有助調查當局確定疑犯的財政狀況、追查罪犯或恐怖分子的財產或資金，以及協助法院審查所有相關的過往交易」。
正確：第8.1段指「備存紀錄可讓金錢服務經營者證明符合打擊洗錢條例載列的規定、本指引及由關長不時公布的其他相關指引」。
正確：第8.2段指「金錢服務經營者應按照本身的業務性質、規模及複雜程度，保存所需及充分的盡職審查資料、交易紀錄及其他紀錄，以符合法定及監管規定」。
正確：第8.2(a)段要求金錢服務經營者確保「為經由金錢服務經營者提存的任何與客戶及客戶的實益擁有人（如適用）有關的資金，戶口或交易，備存清晰及完備的審計線索」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.3–8.5 and footnote 66
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3至8.5段及註腳66

en.q: Regarding the documents, correspondence and transaction records that an MSO should keep, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO should keep the other documents and records obtained throughout the CDD and ongoing monitoring process, including SDD and EDD.
An MSO is not expected to keep every item of correspondence, such as a series of emails with the customer, but should keep enough to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO.
At a minimum, the business correspondence an MSO keeps should include all correspondence about the fees and exchange rates offered to the customer.
An MSO should keep the documents and records obtained or generated in connection with each transaction it carries out, both domestic and international.
For the five-year retention of records on occasional transactions, virtual asset transfers share the $120,000 CDD threshold that applies to other types of transactions.
notes: Correct: ¶8.3(b) has an MSO keep “other documents and records obtained throughout the CDD and ongoing monitoring process, including SDD and EDD”.

Correct: footnote 66 says an MSO is “not expected to keep each and every correspondence, such as a series of emails with the customer”; the expectation is that sufficient correspondence is kept to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO.

Incorrect: ¶8.3(d) says the business correspondence kept should at a minimum include “business correspondence material to CDD measures or significant changes to the operation of the account”; correspondence about fees and exchange rates is not named.
Correct: ¶8.5 has an MSO maintain the documents, data and information “obtained or generated in connection with each transaction the MSO carries out, both domestic and international”.
Incorrect: ¶8.4 sets the CDD threshold at “$8,000 for wire transfers and virtual asset transfers involving virtual assets”; $120,000 applies to other types of transactions.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者應備存的文件、通訊及交易紀錄，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應備存在執行盡職審查或持續監察程序（包括簡化及更嚴格的盡職審查）期間取得的其他文件及紀錄。
金錢服務經營者不須保存每一封通訊（例如與客戶的連串電郵），但應保存足夠通訊，顯示已遵守《打擊洗錢條例》的規定。
金錢服務經營者與客戶的業務通訊，最低限度應備存所有關於向客戶提供的收費及兌換率的通訊。
金錢服務經營者應就其進行的每項本地及國際交易，備存在與交易有關連的情況下取得或產生的文件及紀錄。
就非經常交易的紀錄應備存至少5年的規定而言，虛擬資產轉帳與其他類別的交易一樣，適用120,000元的盡職審查門檻。
notes: 正確：第8.3(b)段要求金錢服務經營者備存「在執行盡職審查或持續監察程序（包括簡化的盡職審查及更嚴格的盡職審查）期間取得的其他文件及紀錄」。
正確：註腳66指「不要求金錢服務經營者要保存每一封通訊，例如與客戶的連串電郵」，但金錢服務經營者應保存足夠通訊，顯示已遵守打擊洗錢條例的規定。
不正確：第8.3(d)段指所備存的業務通訊「最低限度應包括與盡職審查措施或戶口的運作有顯著改變有關的業務通訊」；關於收費及兌換率的通訊並不在其中。
正確：第8.5段要求金錢服務經營者「就每項由該金錢服務經營者進行的（本地及國際）交易」，備存在與該項交易有關連的情況下取得或產生的文件及資料紀錄。
不正確：第8.4段指盡職審查門檻是「電傳轉帳和涉及虛擬資產的虛擬資產轉帳為8,000元」，120,000元則適用於其他類別的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.1至9.4段及第9.8(a)段

en.q: Regarding the role of staff training and what staff should be made aware of, which of the following are correct?
statements: The effective implementation of even a well-designed internal control system can be compromised if the staff using the system are not adequately trained.
The scope and frequency of training should be tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the staff's job functions, responsibilities and experience.
An MSO should implement a clear and well articulated policy for ensuring that its relevant staff receive adequate training on AML/CFT matters.
Staff should know the possible consequences of failing to comply with the CDD and record-keeping requirements laid down in the DTROP, as well as their own and their MSO's statutory obligations.
One way to monitor the effectiveness of training is to test staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF and their ability to recognise suspicious transactions.
notes: Correct: ¶9.1 says “The effective implementation of even a well-designed internal control system can be compromised if staff using the system is not adequately trained.”

Correct: ¶9.2 says “The scope and frequency of training should be tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the job functions, responsibilities and experience of the staff.”
Correct: ¶9.3 says “An MSO should implement a clear and well articulated policy for ensuring that relevant staff receive adequate AML/CFT training.”

Incorrect: ¶9.4(a) refers to the possible consequences for failure to comply with CDD and record-keeping requirements “under the AMLO”; the DTROP is named in ¶9.4(b), for failure to report suspicious transactions.

Correct: ¶9.8(a) lists “testing staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF, the understanding of their statutory and regulatory obligations, and also their ability to recognise suspicious transactions”.

tc.q: 關於職員培訓的角色及應促使職員留意的事項，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 如沒有為使用系統的職員提供充分培訓，則即使是一個設計精湛的內部監控系統，其成效也會受到影響。
培訓的範疇及頻密程度應切合金錢服務經營者面對的特定風險，並應顧及有關職員的職能、職責及經驗。
金錢服務經營者應實施清晰及明確的政策，確保在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面為有關職員提供充分培訓。
應促使職員留意未能遵守《販毒（追討得益）條例》所訂的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定的可能後果，以及本身及金錢服務經營者的法定責任。
監察培訓效用的方法之一，是測試職員對金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策及程序的理解，以及他們辨認可疑交易的能力。
notes: 正確：第9.1段指「如沒有為使用系統的職員提供充分培訓，則即使是一個設計精湛的內部監控系統，其成效也會受到影響」。
正確：第9.2段指「培訓的範疇及頻密程度應切合金錢服務經營者面對的特定風險，並顧及職員的職能、職責及經驗」。
正確：第9.3段指「金錢服務經營者應實施清晰及明確的政策，確保在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面，為有關職員提供充分培訓」。
不正確：第9.4(a)段所指的是「根據打擊洗錢條例因未能遵守盡職審查及備存紀錄規定而可能需要承擔的後果」；《販毒（追討得益）條例》見於第9.4(b)段，涉及未能舉報可疑交易的後果。
正確：第9.8(a)段列出「測試職員對金錢服務經營者在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的政策及程序及對他們的法定及監管責任的理解，以及他們辨認可疑交易的能力」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5至9.6段

en.q: Regarding the areas of training that may suit particular groups of staff and the techniques and tools for delivering training, which of the following are correct?
statements: All new staff, whatever their seniority, may be given an introduction to the background to ML/TF and to the importance that the MSO places on ML/TF.
The areas of training that may be appropriate for MLROs include training to keep abreast of AML/CFT requirements and developments generally.
Back-office staff, depending on their roles, may be trained on how to recognise unusual activities, including abnormal settlements, payments or delivery instructions.
Higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime is identified as appropriate for staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel.
The techniques and tools used to deliver training may include on-line learning systems, focused classroom training, relevant videos and paper- or intranet-based procedures manuals.
notes: Correct: ¶9.5(a)(i) lists, for all new staff irrespective of seniority, “an introduction to the background to ML/TF and the importance placed on ML/TF by the MSO”.
Correct: ¶9.5(e)(ii) lists, for MLROs, “training to keep abreast of AML/CFT requirements/developments generally”.
Correct: ¶9.5(c)(ii) lists, for back-office staff depending on their roles, “how to recognise unusual activities including abnormal settlements, payments or delivery instructions”.

Incorrect: ¶9.5(d)(i) identifies “higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime” for managerial staff including internal audit officers and COs, not for staff dealing directly with the public.
Correct: ¶9.6 says the techniques and tools “may include on-line learning systems, focused classroom training, relevant videos as well as paper- or intranet-based procedures manuals”.

tc.q: 關於或適用於特定類別職員的培訓範疇，以及提供培訓的技巧及工具，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 不論資歷，所有新職員均可接受有關洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的背景，以及金錢服務經營者對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集問題的重視的簡介。
或適用於洗錢報告主任的培訓範疇，包括與打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集所有一般規定及發展同步的培訓。
後勤職員（視乎他們的職責）可接受如何識別不尋常活動的培訓，包括不正常的結算、付款及交付指示。
涵蓋金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度各方面的更高層次培訓，被列為或適用於與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）。
提供培訓的技巧及工具可包括網上學習系統、課堂上的集思培訓、相關影片，以及紙張形式或以內聯網為本的程序手冊。
notes: 正確：第9.5(a)(i)段就所有新職員（不論資歷）列出「洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的背景及金錢服務經營者對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集問題的重視的簡介」。
正確：第9.5(e)(ii)段就洗錢報告主任列出「與打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集所有一般規定/發展同步的培訓」。
正確：第9.5(c)(ii)段就後勤職員（視乎他們的職責）列出「如何識別不尋常活動，包括不正常的結算、付款及交付指示」。
不正確：第9.5(d)(i)段把涵蓋金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度各方面的「更高層次的培訓」列為適用於經理級人員（包括內部審計人員及合規主任），而非與公眾有直接接觸的職員。
正確：第9.6段指「這些技巧及工具可包括網上學習系統、課堂上的集思培訓、相關影片及紙張形式或以內聯網為本的程序手冊」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)至(f)段

en.q: Which of the following are among the red flag indicators that the Guideline lists to help assess whether transactions and activities might give rise to grounds of ML/TF/PF suspicion?
statements: In trade-based related transactions, shipment of the commodity to (or from) a country or jurisdiction that has been designated as “higher risk” for ML/TF/PF activities
Large and regular payments that can be clearly identified as genuine transactions, from and to countries or jurisdictions designated as “higher risk” for ML/TF/PF activities
Among other types of transactions, false information arising during the identification process, or third parties being used to transfer funds so as to conceal the sender and/or receiver of moneys
Remittances or wire transfers originated from or sent to high-risk jurisdictions without reasonable explanation, which are not consistent with the customer's usual foreign business dealings
An agent or counterpart of the MSO with a high volume of large or suspicious transactions in comparison to its own transactions in previous years
As regards customer's behaviour, a customer who fails to reasonably justify the purpose of a transaction, or to provide a legitimate reason, upon the MSO's enquiry
notes: Correct: ¶7.10(c)(i) lists, among trade-based related transactions, where “the commodity is shipped to (or from) a country or jurisdiction designated as ‘higher risk’ for ML/TF/PF activities”.

Incorrect: ¶7.10(b)(vii) lists “large and regular payments that cannot be clearly identified as genuine transactions”, from and to countries or jurisdictions designated as ‘higher risk’; payments that can be clearly identified as genuine are the reverse of that indicator.
Correct: ¶7.10(d)(v) lists “false information during the identification process or use of third parties to transfer funds aimed at concealing the sender and/or receiver of moneys”.

Correct: ¶7.10(d)(vii) lists “remittance/wire transfers originated from or sent to high-risk jurisdictions without reasonable explanation, which are not consistent with the customer's usual foreign business dealings”.

Incorrect: ¶7.10(e)(ii) lists a “high volume of large or suspicious transactions in comparison to other agents or counterparts of MSO in the same area”; the comparison is with other agents or counterparts in the same area, not with the agent's own earlier years.
Correct: ¶7.10(f)(v) lists where “the customer fails to reasonably justify the purpose of a transaction or provide a legitimate reason upon MSO's enquiry”.

tc.q: 指引列出若干指標，有助評估交易及活動是否可能會產生懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集情況的理據。下列哪些屬於所列的指標？
statements: 在貿易相關的交易中，付運商品往返某個被指認為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動「較高風險」的國家或司法管轄區
可清楚識別為真正交易的定期大額支付，款項往來被指認為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動「較高風險」的國家或司法管轄區
就其他類別的交易而言，識別過程中涉及虛假資料，或利用第三方轉帳，藉以掩藏匯款人及／或收款人的身分
匯款或電傳轉帳來自或匯往高風險司法管轄區而沒有合理解釋，並且與客戶慣常的外地業務往來不相稱
金錢服務經營者的代理人或交易對手進行大量的大額或可疑交易，有別於其本身在以往年度所進行的交易
就客戶的行為而言，在金錢服務經營者的詢問下，客戶未能就某項交易的目的提供合理解釋或正當理由
notes: 正確：第7.10(c)(i)段就貿易相關的交易列出「付運商品往返某個被指認為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動『較高風險』的國家或司法管轄區」。
不正確：第7.10(b)(vii)段列出的是「無法清楚識別為真正交易的定期大額支付」，款項匯出及匯入被指認為「較高風險」的國家或司法管轄區；可清楚識別為真正交易的支付與該指標剛好相反。
正確：第7.10(d)(v)段在其他類別的交易中列出「在識別過程中發現虛假資料，或藉第三方轉帳以隱藏匯款人及／或收款人的身分」。
正確：第7.10(d)(vii)段列出「匯款／電傳轉帳來自或匯往高風險司法管轄區而沒有合理解釋，這與客戶慣常的外地業務往來不相稱」。
不正確：第7.10(e)(ii)段列出的是「進行大量的大額或可疑交易，有別於同一地區的其他金錢服務經營者代理人或交易對手」；比較的對象是同一地區的其他代理人或交易對手，而非其本身以往年度的交易。
正確：第7.10(f)(v)段在客戶的行為中列出「在金錢服務經營者的詢問下，客戶未能就某項交易的目的提供合理解釋或正當理由」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)及(c)至(f)段

en.q: Which of the following appear in the Guideline's non-exhaustive list of red flag indicators of suspicious transactions and activities?
statements: Funds being routed through various financial institutions or persons when there is no need to do so, among transactions which do not make economic sense
In trade-based related transactions, the value reported for a commodity on the invoice differing significantly from the commodity's fair market value
Among the other types of transactions listed, a change being made to the address or to the authorised signatories
Among indicators concerning agents or counterparts of MSO, being reluctant to provide the identification information of customers
In terms of customers' behaviour, a customer who is in a hurry to complete the transaction and promises to provide the supporting information retrospectively
Cash or other payments received from third party entities, including entities that have an apparent connection with the transaction
notes: Correct: ¶7.10(a)(vi) lists, among transactions which do not make economic sense, “unnecessary routing of funds through various FIs or persons”.

Correct: ¶7.10(c)(iv) lists, among trade-based related transactions, where “significant discrepancies appear between the value of the commodity reported on the invoice and the commodity's fair market value”.
Incorrect: ¶7.10(d)(iii) lists “frequent changes to the address or authorised signatories”; without “frequent”, any single change would count.
Correct: ¶7.10(e)(i) lists, for agents or counterparts of MSO, “reluctance to provide customers' identification information”.
Correct: ¶7.10(f)(ii) lists where “the customer is in a hurry to complete the transaction, with promises to provide the supporting information retrospectively”.

Incorrect: ¶7.10(c)(vii) lists the receipt of cash (or other payments) “from third party entities that have no apparent connection with the transaction”; third parties with an apparent connection fall outside the indicator.

tc.q: 下列哪些見於指引所列的可疑交易及活動指標（非詳盡無遺）？
statements: 不合乎經濟原則的交易中，資金在沒有需要的情況下經不同金融機構或人士調度往來
在貿易相關的交易中，商品在發票上的價值與其市場價值之間出現重大差異
就指引所列的其他類別的交易而言，地址或獲授權簽署人有所改變
就金錢服務經營者的代理人或交易對手而言，對提供其客戶的識別資料有所抗拒
就客戶的行為而言，客戶急於完成交易，並承諾日後會補交證明資料
從第三方收取現金（或其他款項），包括與交易本身有明顯聯繫的實體
notes: 正確：第7.10(a)(vi)段在不合乎經濟原則的交易中列出「通過不同金融機構或人士，進行不必要的資金調度往來」。
正確：第7.10(c)(iv)段在貿易相關的交易中列出「發票上的商品價值與市場上的商品價值有重大差異」。
不正確：第7.10(d)(iii)段列出的是「頻繁地改變地址或獲授權簽署人」；所述遺漏了「頻繁」這項限制，令任何一次改變均屬指標。
正確：第7.10(e)(i)段就金錢服務經營者的代理人或交易對手列出「不願提供客戶的識別資料」。
正確：第7.10(f)(ii)段在客戶的行為中列出「客戶急於完成交易，並承諾會補交證明資料」。
不正確：第7.10(c)(vii)段列出的是從第三方收取現金（或其他款項），「而該實體與交易本身沒明顯聯繫」；與交易有明顯聯繫的第三方並不在該指標之內。

en.q: Regarding suspicious transaction reporting and the court documents an MSO may be served with by law enforcement agencies, which of the following are correct?
statements: For the suspicious transaction reporting regime, knowledge is, generally speaking, likely to include actual knowledge and knowledge of circumstances which would indicate facts to a reasonable person.

In reporting suspicious transactions, an urgent reporting may be required where, for example, the customer has instructed the MSO to make cash available for collection or to carry out significant changes to the business relationship.
Where imminent action such as the issue of a restraint order on an account is needed, the MSO should take appropriate action and seek legal advice where necessary.
An MSO's record of all ML/TF reports made to the MLRO should include the date each report was made, the results of the assessment and information to allow the relevant papers to be located.

The court documents with which law enforcement agencies may serve an MSO, pursuant to relevant legislation in Hong Kong, include search warrants, production orders, restraint orders and confiscation orders.
notes: Correct: ¶7.2 says that, generally speaking, knowledge is likely to include “(a) actual knowledge; (b) knowledge of circumstances which would indicate facts to a reasonable person”, as well as knowledge of circumstances which would put a reasonable person on inquiry.

Correct: ¶7.21 gives, as examples of when an urgent reporting is required, a customer who has instructed the MSO to move funds or other property, close the account, “make cash available for collection, or carry out significant changes to the business relationship”.

Correct: ¶7.24 says that if there is no need for imminent action, e.g. the issue of a restraint order on an account, consent will usually be given for the MSO to operate the account, and adds: “Otherwise, the MSO should take appropriate action and seek legal advice where necessary.”

Correct: ¶7.29 says the record should include details of “the date the report was made”, the staff members subsequently handling the report, “the results of the assessment”, whether the internal report resulted in an STR to the JFIU, and “information to allow the papers relevant to the report to be located”.

Correct: ¶7.31 says an MSO may be served with various court documents from law enforcement agencies, “e.g. search warrants, production orders, restraint orders or confiscation orders, pursuant to relevant legislations in Hong Kong”.

tc.q: 關於可疑交易報告，以及執法機構或會向金錢服務經營者送達的法庭文件，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 就可疑交易舉報制度而言，一般來說，知悉可能包括實際知悉，以及知悉一個合理的人會認為是事實的情況。
就可疑交易作出報告時，如出現例如客戶已指示金錢服務經營者安排現金備取或對業務關係作出重大變動等情況，便可能須作出緊急報告。
在需要立即採取行動（例如就有關帳戶發出限制令）的情況下，金錢服務經營者便應採取適當行動，並按需要徵詢法律意見。
向洗錢報告主任作出的所有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集報告的紀錄，應收錄作出報告日期、評估結果及相關文件存放何處等詳情。
執法機構根據香港相關法例向金錢服務經營者送達的法庭文件，例如可以是搜查令、提交令、限制令或沒收令。
notes: 正確：第7.2段指一般而言，知悉可能包括「(a)實際知悉；(b)知悉一個合理的人會認為是事實的情況」，亦包括知悉某些會令合理的人提出查詢的情況。
正確：第7.21段以客戶已指示金錢服務經營者移動資金或其他財產、結束戶口、「安排現金備取或對業務關係作出重大變動」等，作為須作出緊急報告的情況的例子。
正確：第7.24段指如無需立即採取行動（例如就有關帳戶發出限制令），財富情報組一般會「同意」金錢服務經營者運作該戶口，「否則金錢服務經營者便應採取適當行動，並按需要徵詢法律意見」。
正確：第7.29段指該紀錄應收錄「作出報告日期」、其後處理報告的人員、「評估結果」、內部報告有否導致須向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，以及「報告的相關文件存放何處」等詳情。
正確：第7.31段指金錢服務經營者或會接獲執法機構根據香港相關法例送達的各種法庭文件，「例如搜查令、提交令、限制令或沒收令」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.3(a) and ¶8.3(c); FAQ applicable to all MSOs (C&ED portal), Q3 and Q28
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(a)及8.3(c)段；《適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題》（海關網站）第3及28問

en.q: Regarding the records an MSO keeps on its customers and on applicants for business, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO should keep the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained in identifying and, where applicable, verifying the identity of a person purporting to act on behalf of the customer.

Where applicable, the documents an MSO keeps, in original or copy, should include those on the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship, with a record of the related data and information.

The AMLO does not require an MSO to maintain the records and documents of unsuccessful applicants for business, but this does not preclude the MSO from retaining them to meet its other statutory obligations.
For the record-keeping requirements, an MSO should retain a certified copy of the “biodata” page of a travel document, which contains the bearer's photograph and biographical details.
notes: Correct: ¶8.3(a) has an MSO keep the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained in identifying and, where applicable, verifying the identity of the customer and/or its beneficial owner “and/or beneficiary and/or persons who purport to act on behalf of the customer” and/or other connected parties.
Correct: ¶8.3(c) lists, “where applicable, the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, on the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship”.

Correct: the FAQ, Q28, says that under the AMLO “there is no requirement for an MSO to maintain records and documents involving unsuccessful applicants”, and that this “does not preclude the MSO from retaining the relevant records and documents in order to meet its other statutory obligations”.

Incorrect: the FAQ, Q3, says an MSO should retain “a copy of the ‘biodata’ page of the travel documents containing the bearer's photograph and biographical details”; it does not ask for the copy to be certified.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者就客戶及業務申請人備存的紀錄，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應備存在識別及（如適用）核實看似是代表客戶行事的人的身分時取得的文件的正本或複本，及如此取得的數據及資料的紀錄。
如適用，金錢服務經營者備存的文件（正本或複本）及有關數據及資料的紀錄，應涵蓋業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質。
《打擊洗錢條例》並無規定金錢服務經營者必須備存涉及被拒申請人的紀錄及文件，但這並不妨礙其為履行其他法定責任而保留該等紀錄及文件。
為符合備存紀錄規定，金錢服務經營者應保存一份經認證的旅遊證件「個人資料頁」複本，即載有持證人照片及個人資料的一頁。
notes: 正確：第8.3(a)段要求金錢服務經營者備存在識別及（如適用）核實任何客戶及／或客戶的實益擁有人「及／或受益人及／或看似是代表客戶行事的人」及／或客戶的其他有關連者的身分時取得的文件的正本或複本，及如此取得的數據及資料的紀錄。
正確：第8.3(c)段列出「（如適用）業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質的文件的正本或複本，以及有關數據及資料的紀錄」。
正確：常見問題第28問指「《打擊洗錢條例》並無規定金錢服務經營者必須備存涉及被拒申請人的紀錄及文件」，但「這並不妨礙有關金錢服務經營者保留相關紀錄及文件，以履行其他法定責任」。
不正確：常見問題第3問指金錢服務經營者應保存「一份在旅遊證件內載有持證人照片及個人資料的『個人資料頁』的複本」；並無要求該複本須經認證。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(c)至(d)段、第9.5(b)(ii)至(iii)段及第9.5(d)(ii)段

en.q: Regarding the matters of which staff should be made aware and the training areas the Guideline suggests for front-line and managerial staff, which of the following are correct?
statements: The ordinances under which staff should be made aware of statutory and regulatory obligations concerning their MSO and themselves, and of the possible consequences of breaches, include the WMD(CPS)O.
The AML/CFT policies and procedures of the MSO, including those for identifying and reporting suspicious transactions, are among the matters of which staff should be made aware.

Staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel, may be trained on the MSO's policies and procedures for the CDD and record-keeping requirements relevant to their job responsibilities.

Staff dealing directly with the public may be trained in circumstances that may give rise to suspicion and in the relevant policies and procedures, such as lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required.

The specific training that may be appropriate for managerial staff, including internal audit officers and COs, includes training on supervising or managing staff and on reporting suspicious transactions to the CCE.
notes: Correct: ¶9.4(c) says staff should be made aware of “any other statutory and regulatory obligations that concern their MSOs and themselves under the DTROP, the OSCO, the UNATMO, the UNSO, the WMD(CPS)O and the AMLO, and the possible consequences of breaches of these obligations”.
Correct: ¶9.4(d) says staff should be made aware of “the MSO's policies and procedures relating to AML/CFT, including suspicious transaction identification and reporting”.

Correct: ¶9.5(b)(ii) lists, for members of staff who are dealing directly with the public, “the MSO's policies and procedures in relation to CDD and record-keeping requirements that are relevant to their job responsibilities”.

Correct: ¶9.5(b)(iii) lists, for the same staff, “training in circumstances that may give rise to suspicion, and relevant policies and procedures, including, for example, lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required”.

Incorrect: ¶9.5(d)(ii) lists, for managerial staff, specific training in relation to their responsibilities for supervising or managing staff, auditing the system and performing random checks “as well as reporting of suspicious transactions to the JFIU”; such reports go to the JFIU, not the CCE.

tc.q: 關於應促使職員留意的事項，以及指引就前線工作人員及經理級人員建議的培訓範疇，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 應促使職員留意與其本身及金錢服務經營者有關的法定及監管責任以及違反的可能後果，所涉條例包括《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》。
金錢服務經營者在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的政策及程序（包括如何識別及舉報可疑交易），屬應促使職員留意的事項。
與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）可接受培訓，認識金錢服務經營者在客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄方面與其職責相關的政策及程序。
與公眾有直接接觸的職員可就可能出現可疑交易的情況及相關政策及程序接受培訓，例如報告的流程及應何時提高額外警覺。
或適用於經理級人員（包括內部審計人員及合規主任）的特定培訓，包括涵蓋監督或管理職員及向關長舉報可疑交易的職責的培訓。
notes: 正確：第9.4(c)段指應促使職員留意「根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《聯合國制裁條例》、《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》及打擊洗錢條例，任何與金錢服務經營者及職員本身職責有關的其他法定及監管責任，以及違反此等責任而可能需要承擔的後果」。
正確：第9.4(d)段指應促使職員留意「金錢服務經營者在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的政策及程序，包括識別及舉報可疑交易」。
正確：第9.5(b)(ii)段就與公眾有直接接觸的職員列出「金錢服務經營者在客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄方面的政策及程序上的規定，而這些規定是與這類職員的職責相關的」。
正確：第9.5(b)(iii)段就這類職員列出「就可能出現可疑交易的情況及相關政策及程序等方面提供培訓，例如報告的流程及應何時提高額外警覺」。
不正確：第9.5(d)(ii)段就經理級人員列出「涵蓋監督或管理職員、系統審查、進行隨機抽查，以及向財富情報組舉報可疑交易的職責的特定培訓」；可疑交易是向財富情報組而非關長舉報。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.2、3.4及7.7段

en.q: Regarding the AML/CFT Systems an MSO should implement and maintain, which of the following are correct?
statements: An MSO should have AML/CFT Systems that its senior management has approved and that enable the MSO to manage and mitigate effectively the risks relevant to it.
An MSO should keep a check on how the AML/CFT Systems approved by its senior management are being implemented, and should enhance those Systems every two years.

As well as having AML/CFT Systems approved by senior management and monitoring their implementation, an MSO should take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate the risks where higher risks are identified.
In implementing its AML/CFT Systems, an MSO should have regard to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses and to the ML/TF risks that arise from those businesses.

For suspicious transaction reporting, an MSO should implement appropriate AML/CFT Systems to fulfil its statutory reporting obligations and properly manage and mitigate the risks of any customer or transaction involved in an STR.
notes: Correct: ¶3.2(a) says an MSO should “have AML/CFT Systems, which are approved by senior management, to enable the MSO to effectively manage and mitigate the risks that are relevant to the MSO”.
Incorrect: ¶3.2(b) has an MSO “monitor the implementation of those AML/CFT Systems referred to in (a), and to enhance them if necessary”; it sets no two-year cycle for enhancing them.

Correct: besides the duties in ¶3.2(a) and (b) to have AML/CFT Systems approved by senior management and to monitor their implementation, ¶3.2(c) says an MSO should “take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate the risks where higher risks are identified”.
Correct: ¶3.4 says an MSO should implement AML/CFT Systems “having regard to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses”.

Correct: ¶7.7 says an MSO should implement appropriate AML/CFT Systems “in order to fulfil its statutory reporting obligations, and properly manage and mitigate the risks associated with any customer or transaction involved in an STR”.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者應推行及維持的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應設有經其高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，使其能有效管理及減低與其相關的風險。
金錢服務經營者應監察其經高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度如何推行，並應每兩年優化該制度一次。
金錢服務經營者除應備有經高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度並監察其推行情況外，亦應在識別出較高風險時採取更嚴格的措施，以管理和減低風險。
金錢服務經營者應顧及本身的業務性質、規模及複雜程度，以及其業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
就報告可疑交易而言，金錢服務經營者應執行適當的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以履行法定舉報責任，並妥為管理和減低因可疑交易報告牽涉任何客戶或交易的風險。
notes: 正確：第3.2(a)段指金錢服務經營者應「備有經高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，確保金錢服務經營者能夠有效管理和減低與該金錢服務經營者相關的風險」。
不正確：第3.2(b)段要求金錢服務經營者「監察(a)項提及的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的推行情況，並視乎需要優化有關制度」；並無規定每兩年優化一次。
正確：除第3.2(a)及(b)段要求備有經高級管理層審批的制度並監察其推行情況外，第3.2(c)段指金錢服務經營者應「在識別出較高風險時採取更嚴格的措施，以管理和減低風險」。
正確：第3.4段指金錢服務經營者應「顧及本身的業務性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險」，推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。
正確：第7.7段指金錢服務經營者應執行適當的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，「以履行其法定的舉報責任，並妥為管理和減低因可疑交易報告牽涉任何客戶或交易所涉的風險」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.10 and footnote 61, ¶7.17(c) and footnote 64
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段及註腳61、第7.17(c)段及註腳64

en.q: Regarding the Guideline's list of red flag indicators and the further guidance it points an MSO to, which of the following are correct?
statements: The list of red flag indicators is not intended to be exhaustive, and only highlights examples of the basic ways in which money may be laundered or used for TF/PF purposes.
For more red flag indicators, reference can be made to relevant guidance issued from time to time by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities.
The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Guidance for Money Service Operators in Detecting Terrorist Financing”.
The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the “Yearly ML/TF Typologies Report” issued by the FATF.
The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers”.
Details of the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions that the JFIU recommends are available on the JFIU's website.
notes: Correct: ¶7.10 says “This list is not intended to be exhaustive and only highlight examples of the basic ways in which money may be laundered or used for TF/PF purposes.”

Correct: footnote 61 says that for more red flag indicators of suspicious transactions and activities, “reference can be made to relevant guidance issued by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities from time to time”.
Incorrect: footnote 61 names the FATF's “Guidance for Financial Institutions in Detecting Terrorist Financing”, issued in April 2002; it names no guidance “for Money Service Operators”.
Incorrect: footnote 61 names the “Yearly ML/TF Typologies Report” issued by the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG), not by the FATF.
Correct: footnote 61 names “Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers”, issued by the FATF in June 2010.
Correct: ¶7.17(c) refers to “the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions recommended by the JFIU”, and footnote 64 says “For details, please see JFIU's website (www.jfiu.gov.hk).”

tc.q: 關於指引所列的可疑交易及活動指標，以及指引提述可供金錢服務經營者參考的其他導引，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 可疑交易及活動的指標清單並非詳盡無遺，僅擬說明若干可作洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集的基本途徑。
如需了解可疑交易及活動指標的詳情，可參考特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關導引。
指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《金錢服務經營者偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》。
指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集案例分析年度報告》。
指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《藉匯款和貨幣兌換供應商洗錢》。
財富情報組推薦用以查問客戶、藉以識別可疑交易的有系統方法，其詳情可於財富情報組網站瀏覽。
notes: 正確：第7.10段指「上述清單並非詳盡無遺，僅擬說明若干可作洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集的基本途徑」。
正確：註腳61指關於可疑交易及活動指標的詳情，「可參考特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關導引」。
不正確：註腳61列出的是特別組織於2002年4月發出的《金融機構偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，並無列出以金錢服務經營者為名的指引。
不正確：註腳61列出的《洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集案例分析年度報告》，是由亞洲／太平洋反清洗黑錢組織發出，並非由特別組織發出。
正確：註腳61列出特別組織於2010年6月發出的《藉匯款和貨幣兌換供應商洗錢》。
正確：第7.17(c)段提述「按照財富情報組推薦的有系統方法來適當地查問客戶」，藉以識別可疑交易，而註腳64指「有關詳情，請瀏覽財富情報組網站（www.jfiu.gov.hk）」。
